examples.en: Would you like some mustard on your hot dog?
examples.zh: 你的熱狗要不要加一點芥末醬？

examples.en: This salad dressing is made with honey and mustard.
examples.zh: 這個沙拉醬是用蜂蜜和芥末醬做的。

examples.en: Mustard seeds are often used in Indian cooking.
examples.zh: 芥菜籽常用於印度料理。

examples.en: The students read a Greek myth about a hero and a monster.
examples.zh: 學生們讀了一則關於英雄與怪物的希臘神話。

examples.en: It is a myth that carrots can give you perfect eyesight.
examples.zh: 胡蘿蔔能讓人擁有完美視力是一種迷思。

examples.en: The teacher helped us separate fact from myth.
examples.zh: 老師幫助我們分辨事實與虛構的說法。

examples.en: She was naive to believe every message she received online.
examples.zh: 她天真地相信網路上收到的每一則訊息。

examples.en: It is naive to think the test will be easy.
examples.zh: 以為考試會很簡單是太天真的想法。

examples.en: The naive tourist paid far too much for a small souvenir.
examples.zh: 那位單純的觀光客花了太多錢買一個小紀念品。

examples.en: The author tells the narrative from a child's point of view.
examples.zh: 作者從孩子的角度來敘述這個故事。

examples.en: Our teacher asked us to write a short narrative about our summer.
examples.zh: 老師要我們寫一篇關於暑假的短篇敘述。

examples.en: The movie has a simple narrative that is easy to follow.
examples.zh: 這部電影的敘事很簡單，容易理解。

examples.en: The two countries asked a neutral group to help them talk.
examples.zh: 兩個國家請一個中立的團體協助雙方對話。

examples.en: She painted the room in neutral colors like white and beige.
examples.zh: 她把房間漆成白色和米色之類的中性色。

examples.en: A good referee must stay neutral during the game.
examples.zh: 好的裁判在比賽中必須保持中立。

examples.en: Our class decided to nominate Amy as the next leader.
examples.zh: 我們班決定提名艾咪擔任下一任班長。

examples.en: Who will you nominate for the school's best student award?
examples.zh: 你要提名誰角逐學校的最佳學生獎？

examples.en: The film was nominated for several awards this year.
examples.zh: 這部電影今年獲得了多項獎項的提名。

examples.en: Her nomination for class president surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 她被提名競選班長，讓大家很驚訝。

examples.en: The committee will announce the nominations next Monday.
examples.zh: 委員會將在下週一公布提名名單。

examples.en: He received a nomination for best actor.
examples.zh: 他獲得最佳男演員的提名。

examples.en: Each nominee will give a short speech tonight.
examples.zh: 每位被提名者今晚都會發表簡短的演說。

examples.en: The nominee thanked her family for their support.
examples.zh: 這位被提名者感謝家人的支持。

examples.en: Three nominees are competing for the teaching award.
examples.zh: 有三位候選人正在競逐教學獎。

examples.en: Wearing a uniform is the norm at most schools in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 在台灣的多數學校，穿制服是常態。

examples.en: In some cultures, giving gifts is a social norm.
examples.zh: 在某些文化中，送禮是一種社會規範。

examples.en: Working late has become the norm in our office.
examples.zh: 加班在我們辦公室已成了常態。

examples.en: There was a noticeable change in her voice.
examples.zh: 她的聲音有明顯的變化。

examples.en: The stain on the shirt is barely noticeable.
examples.zh: 襯衫上的污漬幾乎看不出來。

examples.en: His noticeable improvement made the teacher proud.
examples.zh: 他顯著的進步讓老師很驕傲。

examples.en: Please notify the office if you cannot come to class.
examples.zh: 如果你無法來上課，請通知辦公室。

examples.en: The airline will notify passengers of any flight changes.
examples.zh: 航空公司會通知乘客任何班機異動。

examples.en: We were notified by email that the meeting was canceled.
examples.zh: 我們收到電子郵件通知，會議已取消。

examples.en: He has a strange notion that homework is a waste of time.
examples.zh: 他有個奇怪的想法，覺得功課是浪費時間。

examples.en: The notion of freedom means different things to different people.
examples.zh: 自由這個概念對不同的人有不同的意義。

examples.en: I have no notion of what she plans to do.
examples.zh: 我完全不知道她打算做什麼。

examples.en: Parents have an obligation to take care of their children.
examples.zh: 父母有義務照顧自己的孩子。

examples.en: There is no obligation to buy anything at the store.
examples.zh: 在這家店沒有非買東西不可的義務。

examples.en: She felt an obligation to help her old friend.
examples.zh: 她覺得自己有責任幫助老朋友。

senses.zh: 不為人知的；難以理解的

examples.en: The singer was obscure until her song went viral online.
examples.zh: 這位歌手在她的歌曲爆紅之前一直默默無名。

examples.en: The meaning of the poem is obscure to most students.
examples.zh: 這首詩的意思對多數學生來說難以理解。

examples.en: An obscure road led to the small village.
examples.zh: 一條鮮為人知的道路通往那個小村莊。

examples.en: Thick fog obscured the road ahead, so we drove slowly.
examples.zh: 濃霧遮住了前方的道路，因此我們放慢車速。

examples.en: Please do not obscure the sign with your bag.
examples.zh: 請不要用你的袋子遮住標示牌。

examples.en: Too many details can obscure the main point of the report.
examples.zh: 太多細節可能會使報告的重點變得模糊。

examples.en: As an observer, she took notes on how the students worked.
examples.zh: 身為觀察者，她記錄了學生們的做事方式。

examples.en: An observer from the school board visited our class this week.
examples.zh: 一位學校董事會的觀察員這週來參觀我們的班級。

examples.en: The observer watched the game quietly from the back.
examples.zh: 這位旁觀者安靜地從後方觀看比賽。

examples.en: The odds of winning the lottery are very low.
examples.zh: 中樂透的機率非常低。

examples.en: Our team beat the odds and won the championship.
examples.zh: 我們的隊伍克服不利情勢，贏得了冠軍。

examples.en: What are the odds that it will rain on our trip?
examples.zh: 我們旅行時下雨的可能性有多大？

examples.en: The family placed fruit as an offering at the temple.
examples.zh: 這家人在廟裡擺上水果作為供品。

examples.en: The restaurant's new dessert offering is very popular.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳新推出的甜點很受歡迎。

examples.en: Each student brought a small offering to the class party.
examples.zh: 每位學生都為班上的派對帶了一份小東西。

examples.en: I like to put olives on my pizza.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在披薩上放橄欖。

examples.en: Olive oil is common in Mediterranean cooking.
examples.zh: 橄欖油在地中海料理中很常見。

examples.en: An old olive tree stands in front of the house.
examples.zh: 房子前面有一棵老橄欖樹。

examples.en: The new bridge will be fully operational by next month.
examples.zh: 這座新橋將在下個月全面啟用。

examples.en: Is the printer operational after the repair?
examples.zh: 印表機修好後可以使用了嗎？

examples.en: The company cut its operational costs this year.
examples.zh: 這家公司今年降低了營運成本。

examples.en: Many students opt to take the bus instead of walking.
examples.zh: 許多學生選擇搭公車而不走路。

examples.en: We decided to opt for the cheaper hotel.
examples.zh: 我們決定選擇比較便宜的旅館。

examples.en: You can opt out of the email list at any time.
examples.zh: 你隨時可以選擇退出這個電子郵件名單。

examples.en: Her optimism helped the team stay positive during the hard times.
examples.zh: 她的樂觀讓團隊在困難時期仍保持正向。

examples.en: There is growing optimism about the economy this year.
examples.zh: 對今年經濟的樂觀情緒正在升高。

examples.en: He faced the exam with optimism and a smile.
examples.zh: 他帶著樂觀的心情與微笑面對考試。

examples.en: Homework on weekends is optional in this class.
examples.zh: 這個班級的週末功課是自由選擇的。

examples.en: Sunroofs are an optional feature on this car.
examples.zh: 天窗是這輛車的選配功能。

examples.en: Attendance at the picnic is optional, but everyone is welcome.
examples.zh: 野餐活動可自由決定是否參加，但歡迎所有人參與。

examples.en: We picked apples in the orchard last weekend.
examples.zh: 我們上週末在果園裡採蘋果。

examples.en: The orchard is full of pear trees.
examples.zh: 這座果園裡種滿了梨樹。

examples.en: Her grandfather owns an orchard near the mountains.
examples.zh: 她的祖父在山區附近有一座果園。

examples.en: A tiny organism in the pond can only be seen under a microscope.
examples.zh: 池塘裡的微小生物只能用顯微鏡才看得到。

examples.en: Every living organism needs energy to survive.
examples.zh: 每一種生物都需要能量才能生存。

examples.en: The science class studied how an organism grows.
examples.zh: 自然課研究了生物如何成長。

examples.en: The judges praised the originality of her painting.
examples.zh: 評審稱讚她那幅畫的獨創性。

examples.en: This project shows great originality and careful planning.
examples.zh: 這個專案展現了很高的創意與縝密的規劃。

examples.en: Originality is important when you write an essay.
examples.zh: 寫作文時，原創性很重要。

examples.en: She wore a new outfit to her cousin's wedding.
examples.zh: 她穿了一套新衣服參加表姊的婚禮。

examples.en: This outfit is perfect for a job interview.
examples.zh: 這套服裝很適合去面試。

examples.en: He spent an hour choosing an outfit for the party.
examples.zh: 他花了一個小時挑選派對要穿的服裝。

senses.zh: 插座；暢貨中心；發洩管道

examples.en: Is there an outlet near the desk for my laptop?
examples.zh: 書桌附近有插座可以讓我接筆電嗎？

examples.en: We bought these shoes at an outlet for half the price.
examples.zh: 我們在暢貨中心以半價買了這雙鞋。

examples.en: Sports are a healthy outlet for stress.
examples.zh: 運動是紓解壓力的健康管道。

examples.en: As an outsider, he did not understand the local customs.
examples.zh: 身為外人，他不了解當地的習俗。

examples.en: The new student felt like an outsider at first.
examples.zh: 這位新同學一開始覺得自己像個外人。

examples.en: The club does not welcome outsiders on weekends.
examples.zh: 這個社團週末不歡迎外人進入。

examples.en: The manager will oversee the whole project.
examples.zh: 經理將負責監督整個專案。

examples.en: A teacher oversees the students during lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐時間有一位老師負責看管學生。

examples.en: She oversees a team of ten people at the bank.
examples.zh: 她在銀行負責管理一個十人的團隊。

examples.en: The court decided to overturn the earlier ruling.
examples.zh: 法院決定推翻先前的判決。

examples.en: Strong winds overturned several tables in the park.
examples.zh: 強風吹翻了公園裡的好幾張桌子。

examples.en: The new coach wants to overturn the old rules.
examples.zh: 新教練想要推翻舊的規則。

senses.zh: 使不堪負荷；壓倒；使不知所措

examples.en: Too much homework can overwhelm a young student.
examples.zh: 太多功課會讓年幼的學生不堪負荷。

examples.en: The sudden noise overwhelmed the baby, and she began to cry.
examples.zh: 突如其來的噪音讓寶寶不知所措，哭了起來。

examples.en: Our team overwhelmed the other side with a score of ten to one.
examples.zh: 我們隊以十比一的比數壓倒對手。

examples.en: A tiny dust particle floated in the sunlight.
examples.zh: 一粒細小的灰塵在陽光中飄浮。

examples.en: Scientists study the smallest particles of matter.
examples.zh: 科學家研究物質中最小的粒子。

examples.en: The air filter removes particles from the room.
examples.zh: 這台空氣濾淨機能去除室內的微粒。

examples.en: The test was difficult partly because the reading section was long.
examples.zh: 這次考試很難，部分原因是閱讀測驗篇幅很長。

examples.en: The road was partly closed for repairs.
examples.zh: 這條路因為維修而部分封閉。

examples.en: She was late partly because of the heavy traffic.
examples.zh: 她遲到有一部分是因為塞車。

examples.en: He is passionate about teaching young children to read.
examples.zh: 他熱衷於教小朋友閱讀。

examples.en: The coach gave a passionate speech before the game.
examples.zh: 教練在比賽前發表了一場充滿熱忱的演說。

examples.en: She is a passionate fan of classical music.
examples.zh: 她是古典音樂的狂熱愛好者。

examples.en: The bakery sells fresh pastries every morning.
examples.zh: 這家麵包店每天早上都賣新鮮的糕點。

examples.en: I had a cup of coffee and a cheese pastry for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早餐喝了一杯咖啡，吃了一個起司糕點。

examples.en: She rolled out the pastry to make a fruit tart.
examples.zh: 她把油酥麵糰壓平，準備做水果塔。

examples.en: Mom sewed a patch on the knee of my jeans.
examples.zh: 媽媽在我牛仔褲的膝蓋處縫了一塊補丁。

examples.en: There is a small vegetable patch behind the house.
examples.zh: 房子後面有一小塊菜圃。

examples.en: The doctor put a patch over her eye.
examples.zh: 醫生在她的眼睛上覆上眼罩。

examples.en: He patched the hole in the tent with tape.
examples.zh: 他用膠帶補好了帳篷上的洞。

examples.en: We patched up the old fence before winter.
examples.zh: 我們在冬天來臨前把舊圍籬修補好了。

examples.en: The company patched the software to fix the problem.
examples.zh: 公司更新了軟體來修正問題。

examples.en: The company has a patent for its new phone design.
examples.zh: 這家公司擁有新手機設計的專利。

examples.en: It took two years to get a patent for the invention.
examples.zh: 為這項發明取得專利花了兩年的時間。

examples.en: The company licenses its patent to other manufacturers for a fee.
examples.zh: 公司向其他製造商收費，授權他們使用這項專利。

examples.en: The lost puppy looked pathetic in the cold rain.
examples.zh: 那隻走失的小狗在冰冷的雨中看起來很可憐。

examples.en: My first attempt at cooking was pathetic.
examples.zh: 我第一次下廚的成果很差勁。

examples.en: It was pathetic to see him beg for another chance.
examples.zh: 看到他乞求再一次機會，真讓人覺得可憐。

examples.en: A police patrol passes our street every night.
examples.zh: 一支警察巡邏隊每天晚上都會經過我們這條街。

examples.en: The guards are on patrol around the school.
examples.zh: 警衛正在學校周圍巡邏。

examples.en: The park has a night patrol for safety.
examples.zh: 公園有夜間巡邏隊以維護安全。

examples.en: Two officers patrol the beach during the summer.
examples.zh: 兩位警員在夏天於海灘上巡邏。

examples.en: Teachers patrol the halls during exams to keep the school quiet.
examples.zh: 考試期間老師會在走廊上巡視，維持校園安靜。

examples.en: Security guards patrol the mall after it closes.
examples.zh: 購物中心打烊後，保全人員會進行巡邏。

senses.zh: 顧客；贊助者；設施使用者

examples.en: The cafe thanked its patrons with a free cookie.
examples.zh: 咖啡廳用一塊免費餅乾感謝它的顧客。

examples.en: She is a generous patron of the local art museum.
examples.zh: 她是當地美術館慷慨的贊助者。

examples.en: The library is open to patrons until nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 圖書館對讀者開放到九點。

examples.en: Drivers must stop for a pedestrian at the crosswalk.
examples.zh: 駕駛人必須在行人穿越道前停車讓行人通過。

examples.en: The pedestrian waited for the green light.
examples.zh: 那位行人等著綠燈亮起。

examples.en: This street is only for pedestrians on weekends.
examples.zh: 這條街週末只供行人通行。

examples.en: A pedestrian bridge crosses the busy road.
examples.zh: 一座行人天橋橫跨這條繁忙的馬路。

examples.en: The city built a new pedestrian path along the river.
examples.zh: 市政府沿著河邊蓋了一條新的步行道。

examples.en: Pedestrian traffic is heavy near the station.
examples.zh: 車站附近的行人流量很大。

examples.en: The nail penetrated the thin wooden wall with a single blow.
examples.zh: 釘子在一記敲擊下穿透了薄薄的木牆。

examples.en: Sunlight can penetrate the forest where gaps appear in the leaves.
examples.zh: 樹葉間出現空隙的地方，陽光就能穿透森林。

examples.en: Rain penetrated the old roof and wet the floor.
examples.zh: 雨水滲過老舊的屋頂，弄濕了地板。

examples.en: My grandfather lives on his monthly pension.
examples.zh: 我的祖父靠每個月的退休金過活。

examples.en: She will receive a pension after thirty years of teaching.
examples.zh: 她教了三十年書後就能領到退休金。

examples.en: The government plans to change the pension system.
examples.zh: 政府打算調整退休金制度。

examples.en: Dogs can perceive sounds that people cannot hear.
examples.zh: 狗能察覺人類聽不到的聲音。

examples.en: Many people perceive him as a kind and honest man.
examples.zh: 許多人認為他是個善良又誠實的人。

examples.en: I perceived a small change in her mood.
examples.zh: 我察覺到她的心情有些小變化。

examples.en: Our perception of time changes when we are bored.
examples.zh: 當我們感到無聊時，對時間的感知會改變。

examples.en: The ad changed the public perception of the brand.
examples.zh: 這則廣告改變了大眾對這個品牌的看法。

examples.en: Her quick perception helped her find the mistake.
examples.zh: 她敏銳的觀察力幫助她找出了錯誤。

examples.en: All hospital personnel must wear masks in the ward.
examples.zh: 醫院所有人員在病房內都必須戴口罩。

examples.en: The company is hiring more personnel for the holiday season.
examples.zh: 公司為了假期旺季而增聘更多人手。

examples.en: Please send your resume to the personnel office.
examples.zh: 請將你的履歷寄到人事部門。

examples.en: Try to see the problem from your sister's perspective.
examples.zh: 試著從你姊姊的角度來看這個問題。

examples.en: Traveling gave him a new perspective on life.
examples.zh: 旅行讓他對人生有了新的看法。

examples.en: The artist used perspective to make the road look long.
examples.zh: 畫家運用透視法讓這條路看起來很長。

examples.en: His pessimism made it hard for the team to feel hopeful.
examples.zh: 他的悲觀讓團隊很難抱持希望。

examples.en: There is growing pessimism about the chances of holding the outdoor concert.
examples.zh: 大家對能否舉辦戶外音樂會越來越悲觀。

examples.en: She tried to replace her pessimism with positive thoughts.
examples.zh: 她試著用正面的想法取代悲觀的念頭。

examples.en: Students signed a petition to keep the library open late.
examples.zh: 學生們連署請願，要求圖書館延長開放時間。

examples.en: The petition collected over a thousand names in a week.
examples.zh: 這份請願書一週內就收集到一千多個簽名。

examples.en: Neighbors sent a petition to the city council.
examples.zh: 鄰居們向市議會遞交了一份請願書。

examples.en: Parents petitioned the school for a safer crosswalk.
examples.zh: 家長們向學校請願，要求設置更安全的斑馬線。

examples.en: They plan to petition the mayor for a new park.
examples.zh: 他們打算向市長請願，要求蓋一座新公園。

examples.en: Residents petitioned to stop the noisy construction.
examples.zh: 居民們請願要求停止吵雜的施工。

examples.en: Let's not argue over such a petty matter.
examples.zh: 我們別為這種瑣碎的小事爭吵。

examples.en: It was petty of him to complain about a small cost.
examples.zh: 他為了一點小錢抱怨，真是小氣。

examples.en: The office keeps petty cash for small expenses.
examples.zh: 辦公室備有零用金，以支付小額開銷。

examples.en: The first phase of the project will finish in March.
examples.zh: 這個專案的第一階段將在三月完成。

examples.en: Many teenagers go through a phase of wanting to be alone.
examples.zh: 許多青少年會經歷一段想要獨處的時期。

examples.en: The moon moves through several phases each month.
examples.zh: 月亮每個月會經歷數種月相變化。

examples.en: The bus company offers a free pickup from the airport.
examples.zh: 這家巴士公司提供免費接機服務。

examples.en: You can arrange a pickup time when you place the order.
examples.zh: 下訂單時，你可以約定取貨時間。

examples.en: My uncle drives a red pickup to his farm every morning.
examples.zh: 我叔叔每天早上開一輛紅色小貨車去他的農場。

examples.en: We walked along the pier and watched the boats come in.
examples.zh: 我們沿著碼頭散步，看著船隻進港。

examples.en: The restaurant at the end of the pier serves fresh fish.
examples.zh: 碼頭盡頭的餐廳供應新鮮的魚。

examples.en: Workers are repairing the concrete pier under the bridge.
examples.zh: 工人正在修補橋下的水泥橋墩。

examples.en: Two tall stone pillars stand at the entrance of the temple.
examples.zh: 兩根高大的石柱矗立在寺廟入口。

examples.en: Honesty is one of the pillars of a good friendship.
examples.zh: 誠實是良好友誼的支柱之一。

examples.en: Mrs. Lin is a pillar of our community.
examples.zh: 林太太是我們社區的中堅分子。

examples.en: A long pipeline carries water from the mountains to the city.
examples.zh: 一條長長的管線把水從山上送往城市。

examples.en: The company has several new products in the pipeline.
examples.zh: 這家公司有好幾項新產品正在籌備中。

examples.en: Workers found a leak in the gas pipeline near the school.
examples.zh: 工人在學校附近的瓦斯管線發現漏氣。

examples.en: The pitcher threw the ball straight to the catcher.
examples.zh: 投手把球直直投向捕手。

examples.en: Please put a pitcher of water on the table.
examples.zh: 請在桌上放一壺水。

examples.en: She is the best pitcher on our school baseball team.
examples.zh: 她是我們學校棒球隊最棒的投手。

examples.en: The mayor ignored the neighbors' plea for a new bus stop.
examples.zh: 市長沒有理會鄰居們要求增設公車站的請求。

examples.en: He made a plea for help when his car broke down.
examples.zh: 他的車拋錨時，他開口懇求協助。

examples.en: The defendant entered a plea of not guilty in court.
examples.zh: 被告在法庭上提出無罪答辯。

examples.en: The little boy pleaded with his mother to buy the toy.
examples.zh: 小男孩央求媽媽買那個玩具。

examples.en: She pleaded for more time to finish the report.
examples.zh: 她懇求多給一點時間完成報告。

examples.en: The manager pleaded guilty to fraud during the court hearing.
examples.zh: 經理在法院審理時承認詐欺罪。

examples.en: The students took a pledge to keep the park clean.
examples.zh: 學生們許下誓言要維護公園的整潔。

examples.en: The company made a pledge to use less plastic.
examples.zh: 這家公司承諾要減少塑膠的使用。

examples.en: Her pledge of one thousand dollars helped the animal shelter.
examples.zh: 她承諾捐出一千元，幫助了動物收容所。

examples.en: I pledge to do my best in every class this year.
examples.zh: 我保證今年每一堂課都盡全力。

examples.en: Many parents pledged money for the new library.
examples.zh: 許多家長承諾捐款給新圖書館。

examples.en: The team pledged to finish the project on time.
examples.zh: 團隊承諾會準時完成專案。

examples.en: The children plunged into the pool on a hot afternoon.
examples.zh: 炎熱的午後，孩子們紛紛跳進泳池。

examples.en: Prices plunged after the store began its summer sale.
examples.zh: 商店開始夏季特賣後，價格大幅下降。

examples.en: He plunged himself into his studies before the exam.
examples.zh: 考試前，他全心投入課業。

examples.en: There was a sudden plunge in the price of vegetables.
examples.zh: 蔬菜價格突然暴跌。

examples.en: She took a plunge into the cold lake.
examples.zh: 她跳進了冰冷的湖裡。

examples.en: The company's sales took a plunge last winter.
examples.zh: 這家公司去年冬天的銷售量驟降。

examples.en: She wrote a poetic description of the sunset.
examples.zh: 她寫了一段富有詩意的夕陽描寫。

examples.en: The old village has a quiet and poetic charm.
examples.zh: 這座古老的村莊有一種寧靜而富詩意的魅力。

examples.en: Our teacher asked us to use poetic language in the essay.
examples.zh: 老師要我們在作文中使用富有詩意的語言。

examples.en: Don't poke the fish with your finger.
examples.zh: 不要用手指去戳那條魚。

examples.en: He poked a hole in the paper with a pencil.
examples.zh: 他用鉛筆在紙上戳了一個洞。

examples.en: The puppy poked its head out of the box.
examples.zh: 小狗從箱子裡探出頭來。

examples.en: She gave her brother a poke in the arm.
examples.zh: 她戳了弟弟的手臂一下。

examples.en: A light poke woke the sleeping cat.
examples.zh: 輕輕一戳就把熟睡的貓叫醒了。

examples.en: Give the fire a poke so it burns better.
examples.zh: 撥一下火，讓它燒得更旺。

examples.en: We sat on the porch and drank iced tea.
examples.zh: 我們坐在門廊上喝冰紅茶。

examples.en: The package was left on the front porch.
examples.zh: 包裹被放在前門廊上。

examples.en: Grandpa likes reading the newspaper on the porch.
examples.zh: 爺爺喜歡在門廊上看報紙。

senses.zh: 作品集；投資組合；公事包

examples.en: She showed her art portfolio to the college teacher.
examples.zh: 她把自己的美術作品集拿給大學老師看。

examples.en: My father keeps a balanced portfolio of stocks and bonds.
examples.zh: 我父親持有股票與債券平衡的投資組合。

examples.en: The designer carried a leather portfolio to the meeting.
examples.zh: 設計師帶著一只皮製公事包去開會。

examples.en: Dr. Chen is a medical practitioner with twenty years of experience.
examples.zh: 陳醫師是一位有二十年經驗的執業醫師。

examples.en: The workshop is open to legal practitioners and students.
examples.zh: 這場工作坊開放給法律從業人員和學生。

examples.en: She is a practitioner of traditional Chinese medicine.
examples.zh: 她是一位傳統中醫的執業者。

examples.en: Wear a helmet as a precaution when you ride a bike.
examples.zh: 騎腳踏車時，戴上安全帽是一種預防措施。

examples.en: The school took extra precautions during the typhoon.
examples.zh: 颱風期間，學校採取了額外的防範措施。

examples.en: We took the precaution of saving a copy of the file.
examples.zh: 我們事先備份了一份檔案以防萬一。

examples.en: The lion is a powerful predator on the African plains.
examples.zh: 獅子是非洲平原上強大的掠食者。

examples.en: Small birds hide in bushes to escape from predators.
examples.zh: 小鳥躲在灌木叢裡以躲避掠食者。

examples.en: The great white shark is a top predator in the ocean.
examples.zh: 大白鯊是海洋中的頂級掠食者。

examples.en: Do you have a preference for tea or coffee?
examples.zh: 你比較喜歡茶還是咖啡？

examples.en: My preference is to travel by train rather than by plane.
examples.zh: 我比較喜歡搭火車旅行，而不是搭飛機。

examples.en: Parents with young children are given preference when seats are limited.
examples.zh: 座位有限時，帶幼兒的家長享有優先權。

examples.en: Prejudice against newcomers can hurt a community.
examples.zh: 對新來者的偏見可能傷害一個社區。

examples.en: The teacher taught us to face our own prejudices honestly.
examples.zh: 老師教我們誠實面對自己的偏見。

examples.en: He had a prejudice against people who talked too loudly.
examples.zh: 他對說話太大聲的人有成見。

examples.en: One bad review should not prejudice you against the book.
examples.zh: 不該因為一則負面評論就對這本書抱持偏見。

examples.en: The long delay may prejudice the company's chances.
examples.zh: 長時間的延誤可能損害這家公司的機會。

examples.en: Please don't let rumors prejudice your opinion of her.
examples.zh: 請不要讓謠言使你對她產生偏見。

examples.en: The preliminary results will be announced next week.
examples.zh: 初步結果將在下週公布。

examples.en: We held a preliminary meeting before the main event.
examples.zh: 我們在正式活動之前先召開了預備會議。

examples.en: Our team passed the preliminary round of the contest.
examples.zh: 我們的隊伍通過了比賽的初賽。

examples.en: Please complete the preliminaries before the interview begins.
examples.zh: 請在面試開始前完成準備工作。

examples.en: She won her race in the preliminaries.
examples.zh: 她在預賽中贏得了自己那一組的比賽。

examples.en: After the usual preliminaries, we started the lesson.
examples.zh: 在例行的開場流程之後，我們開始上課。

examples.en: It is premature to decide before we see all the data.
examples.zh: 在看到所有資料前就做決定還太早。

examples.en: The baby was born premature and stayed in the hospital.
examples.zh: 這個嬰兒是早產兒，出生後留在醫院。

examples.en: The team's premature celebration made them look foolish.
examples.zh: 球隊過早慶祝，讓他們顯得很傻。

examples.en: This is the premier art museum in the country.
examples.zh: 這是全國首屈一指的美術館。

examples.en: The premier event of the week is the school concert.
examples.zh: 本週最重要的活動是學校音樂會。

examples.en: She works for a premier law firm in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她任職於台北一家頂尖的律師事務所。

examples.en: The premier gave a speech about the new budget.
examples.zh: 總理發表了一場關於新預算的演說。

examples.en: The premier visited our school to talk with the students.
examples.zh: 總理造訪了我們的學校，與學生交談。

examples.en: Reporters asked the premier several questions about education.
examples.zh: 記者向總理提出了幾個關於教育的問題。

senses.zh: 前提；房屋及其用地（用複數）

examples.en: The whole plan is based on a false premise.
examples.zh: 整個計畫建立在一個錯誤的前提上。

examples.en: We accepted the premise that everyone would work hard.
examples.zh: 我們接受了大家都會努力工作的前提。

examples.en: Smoking is not allowed on the premises of the school.
examples.zh: 學校校園內禁止吸菸。

examples.en: We pay the insurance premium every month.
examples.zh: 我們每個月繳交保險費。

examples.en: You must pay a premium for tickets close to the stage.
examples.zh: 靠近舞台的票必須額外付費。

examples.en: Fresh fruit sells at a premium during the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期期間新鮮水果的售價會有溢價。

examples.en: The shop sells premium coffee from Taiwan.
examples.zh: 這家店販售台灣出產的高級咖啡。

examples.en: Premium members can enter the lounge for free.
examples.zh: 高級會員可以免費進入貴賓室。

examples.en: They bought premium tickets for the concert.
examples.zh: 他們買了這場音樂會的貴賓票。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed medicine for my sore throat.
examples.zh: 醫生開了藥給我治喉嚨痛。

examples.en: The rules prescribe how the form should be filled out.
examples.zh: 規定中明訂了表格該如何填寫。

examples.en: The school prescribes a uniform for all students.
examples.zh: 學校規定所有學生都要穿制服。

examples.en: The doctor wrote a prescription for the allergy medicine.
examples.zh: 醫生開了過敏藥的處方箋。

examples.en: You need a prescription to buy this kind of medicine.
examples.zh: 購買這種藥需要處方箋。

examples.en: I took the prescription to the pharmacy near my house.
examples.zh: 我把處方箋拿到家附近的藥局。

senses.zh: 總統職位；總統任期；會長或社長職位

examples.en: She hopes to win the presidency of the student council.
examples.zh: 她希望當選學生會會長一職。

examples.en: The country grew stronger during his presidency.
examples.zh: 在他的總統任期內，這個國家變得更強盛。

examples.en: The presidency of the club changes hands every year.
examples.zh: 這個社團的社長職位每年輪替。

examples.en: The store is closed, presumably because of the holiday.
examples.zh: 商店沒有開，大概是因為假日。

examples.en: Presumably, you have already read the instructions.
examples.zh: 想必你已經讀過說明了。

examples.en: He is late, presumably stuck in traffic.
examples.zh: 他遲到了，大概是塞在車陣中。

examples.en: I presume you have already had lunch.
examples.zh: 我猜你已經吃過午餐了。

examples.en: We presumed that the meeting would start on time.
examples.zh: 我們原本以為會議會準時開始。

examples.en: Don't presume to speak for everyone in the class.
examples.zh: 不要擅自代表全班同學發言。

examples.en: Cool and rainy weather prevails in the north during winter.
examples.zh: 冬季北部盛行涼爽多雨的天氣。

examples.en: We hope that common sense will prevail in the end.
examples.zh: 我們希望常理最終能占上風。

examples.en: The belief that breakfast is important still prevails in many homes.
examples.zh: 許多家庭仍普遍相信早餐很重要。

examples.en: The eagle watched its prey from high in the sky.
examples.zh: 老鷹從高空盯著牠的獵物。

examples.en: Mice are common prey for owls.
examples.zh: 老鼠是貓頭鷹常見的獵物。

examples.en: The cat crouched low, waiting for its prey.
examples.zh: 貓壓低身子，等待牠的獵物。

examples.en: Owls prey on small animals at night.
examples.zh: 貓頭鷹在夜間捕食小動物。

examples.en: Some dishonest people prey on elderly customers.
examples.zh: 有些不誠實的人專門欺騙年長的顧客。

examples.en: Worry about the exam preyed on her mind all week.
examples.zh: 對考試的擔憂整個星期都折磨著她。

examples.en: You need prior permission to enter the lab.
examples.zh: 進入實驗室需要事先許可。

examples.en: I had a prior appointment, so I could not join the dinner.
examples.zh: 我先前已有約，所以無法參加晚餐。

examples.en: Prior experience is helpful but not required for this job.
examples.zh: 先前的經驗有幫助，但不是這份工作的必要條件。

examples.en: The principal proclaimed the start of the school festival.
examples.zh: 校長宣布校慶活動開始。

examples.en: The banner proclaims the opening of a new library.
examples.zh: 布條宣告新圖書館啟用。

examples.en: The mayor proclaimed a day of celebration for the city.
examples.zh: 市長宣布這座城市要有一天的慶祝活動。

examples.en: Good sleep can improve your productivity at work.
examples.zh: 充足的睡眠能提高你的工作效率。

examples.en: The new software helped boost our productivity.
examples.zh: 這套新軟體幫助我們提升了生產力。

examples.en: A tidy desk may increase your productivity.
examples.zh: 整潔的書桌可能提高你的效率。

examples.en: Please upload a photo to your online profile.
examples.zh: 請在你的線上個人檔案中上傳一張照片。

examples.en: The artist drew a profile of the girl's face.
examples.zh: 畫家畫了女孩臉部的側面像。

examples.en: The newspaper ran a short profile of the new coach.
examples.zh: 報紙刊登了一篇新教練的簡介。

examples.en: The magazine profiled several young chefs this month.
examples.zh: 這份雜誌本月介紹了幾位年輕主廚。

examples.en: The article profiles a farmer who grows organic rice.
examples.zh: 這篇文章介紹了一位種植有機稻米的農夫。

examples.en: The program profiled the school's best athletes.
examples.zh: 這個節目介紹了學校最優秀的運動員。

examples.en: The book had a profound effect on her life.
examples.zh: 這本書對她的人生產生了深遠的影響。

examples.en: The teacher asked a profound question about honesty.
examples.zh: 老師提出了一個關於誠實的深刻問題。

examples.en: We felt a profound sadness when the old teacher left.
examples.zh: 那位老教師離開時，我們感到深深的悲傷。

examples.en: The projection shows sales will rise by ten percent.
examples.zh: 預測顯示銷售額將成長百分之十。

examples.en: The teacher used a projection of the map on the screen.
examples.zh: 老師在螢幕上投影了這張地圖。

examples.en: A small projection on the wall holds the lamp.
examples.zh: 牆上一個小小的突出物托著那盞燈。

examples.en: Heavy rain prolonged the trip by two hours.
examples.zh: 大雨讓旅程延長了兩小時。

examples.en: Don't prolong the meeting with unnecessary questions.
examples.zh: 不要用不必要的問題拖長會議。

examples.en: Regular exercise may help prolong your life.
examples.zh: 規律運動可能有助於延年益壽。

examples.en: This area is prone to floods in the summer.
examples.zh: 這個地區夏季容易淹水。

examples.en: Children are prone to catching colds in winter.
examples.zh: 小孩在冬天容易感冒。

examples.en: She lay prone on the mat during the stretching exercise.
examples.zh: 她在伸展運動時俯臥在墊子上。

examples.en: The poster was part of a propaganda campaign.
examples.zh: 這張海報是宣傳活動的一部分。

examples.en: Students learned how to spot propaganda in old newspapers.
examples.zh: 學生們學習如何辨認舊報紙中帶有偏向的宣傳。

examples.en: The old film was full of propaganda about the country.
examples.zh: 那部老電影充滿了關於這個國家的宣傳。

examples.en: The story tells of a prophet who warned the king.
examples.zh: 這個故事描述一位警告國王的先知。

examples.en: Many people called him a prophet of the new age.
examples.zh: 許多人稱他為新時代的預言家。

examples.en: The prophet in the old tale predicted a great flood.
examples.zh: 古老故事裡的先知預言會有一場大洪水。

examples.en: The prosecution presented new evidence in court.
examples.zh: 檢方在法庭上提出了新的證據。

examples.en: The prosecution of the case took several months.
examples.zh: 這個案件的起訴過程花了好幾個月。

examples.en: The lawyer for the prosecution asked the witness a question.
examples.zh: 檢方律師向證人提問。

senses.zh: 供應；條款；糧食儲備（用複數）

examples.en: The city is responsible for the provision of clean water.
examples.zh: 市政府負責供應乾淨的水。

examples.en: The contract has a provision for early payment.
examples.zh: 合約中有一項提前付款的條款。

examples.en: The hikers packed provisions for three days.
examples.zh: 登山客準備了三天份的糧食。

examples.en: Don't provoke the dog by pulling its tail.
examples.zh: 不要拉狗的尾巴去惹牠生氣。

examples.en: The speech provoked a lively discussion in class.
examples.zh: 這場演講在班上引起了熱烈的討論。

examples.en: Her joke provoked laughter from the whole room.
examples.zh: 她的笑話引得全場哄堂大笑。

examples.en: The nurse checked my pulse and my temperature.
examples.zh: 護理師檢查了我的脈搏和體溫。

examples.en: Your pulse gets faster when you run.
examples.zh: 跑步的時候，你的脈搏會變快。

examples.en: We could feel the pulse of the music through the floor.
examples.zh: 我們透過地板感受到音樂的節奏。

examples.en: Her heart pulsed with excitement before the game.
examples.zh: 比賽前她的心因興奮而怦怦跳動。

examples.en: Lights pulsed in time with the music.
examples.zh: 燈光隨著音樂節奏閃動。

examples.en: Blood pulses through the arteries with each beat of the heart.
examples.zh: 心臟每跳動一次，血液便在動脈中形成一次脈動。

senses.zh: 金字塔；角錐；金字塔形結構

examples.en: We learned how the ancient pyramid was built.
examples.zh: 我們學到古代金字塔是怎麼蓋成的。

examples.en: The students drew a pyramid in their geometry class.
examples.zh: 學生們在幾何課中畫了一個角錐。

examples.en: The cheerleaders formed a human pyramid during the halftime show.
examples.zh: 啦啦隊員在中場表演時疊出了一座人體金字塔。

examples.en: Her quest for the truth took many years.
examples.zh: 她追尋真相花了許多年。

examples.en: The hero set out on a quest to find the lost key.
examples.zh: 主角踏上尋找遺失鑰匙的旅程。

examples.en: In the game, you must finish each quest to level up.
examples.zh: 在這個遊戲中，你必須完成每個任務才能升級。

examples.en: Please fill out this questionnaire before you leave.
examples.zh: 離開前請填寫這份問卷。

examples.en: The school sent a questionnaire to every parent.
examples.zh: 學校寄了一份問卷給每位家長。

examples.en: The online questionnaire takes only five minutes.
examples.zh: 這份線上問卷只需要五分鐘。

examples.en: The little dog quivered with fear during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間，小狗嚇得發抖。

examples.en: Her voice quivered when she began the speech.
examples.zh: 她開始演講時，聲音微微顫抖。

examples.en: The leaves quivered in the cold wind.
examples.zh: 樹葉在冷風中微微顫動。

examples.en: There was a quiver in his voice as he spoke.
examples.zh: 他說話的聲音有些顫抖。

examples.en: The archer pulled an arrow from her quiver.
examples.zh: 弓箭手從箭袋中抽出一支箭。

examples.en: A quiver of excitement ran through the crowd.
examples.zh: 一陣興奮的顫動傳遍人群。

examples.en: Each student has a quota of ten free prints a month.
examples.zh: 每位學生每個月有十張免費列印的額度。

examples.en: The factory reached its monthly sales quota.
examples.zh: 這間工廠達成了每月的銷售目標。

examples.en: The government set a quota on imported rice.
examples.zh: 政府對進口稻米設定了配額。

examples.en: The school held a talk about racism and how to stop it.
examples.zh: 學校舉辦了一場關於種族歧視以及如何終止它的講座。

examples.en: Racism can hurt people at work as well as in class.
examples.zh: 種族歧視在職場和課堂上都可能傷害他人。

examples.en: Her essay explains why racism is still a problem in many countries.
examples.zh: 她的文章說明了為什麼種族歧視在許多國家仍是問題。

examples.en: Please put your umbrella on the rack by the door.
examples.zh: 請把你的雨傘放在門邊的架子上。

examples.en: The store has a large rack of winter coats on sale.
examples.zh: 這家店有一大排特價冬季外套的衣架。

examples.en: He bought a bike rack for the back of his car.
examples.zh: 他買了一個裝在車尾的單車架。

examples.en: Guilt racked her mind after she broke the vase.
examples.zh: 打破花瓶後，罪惡感折磨著她的心。

examples.en: A bad cough racked his body all night.
examples.zh: 一陣嚴重的咳嗽讓他整晚痛苦不堪。

examples.en: Worry racked the team before the final exam.
examples.zh: 期末考前，擔憂折磨著整個團隊。

examples.en: The boy wore a ragged jacket that was too big for him.
examples.zh: 那個男孩穿著一件太大又破爛的外套。

examples.en: We found a ragged old map in the attic.
examples.zh: 我們在閣樓裡發現一張破舊的地圖。

examples.en: The cliff had a ragged edge above the sea.
examples.zh: 那座懸崖在海面上方有著參差不齊的邊緣。

examples.en: Police made a raid on the illegal factory last night.
examples.zh: 警方昨晚突襲了那間非法工廠。

examples.en: The museum improved its security after a raid.
examples.zh: 那座博物館在遭到襲擊後加強了安全措施。

examples.en: The inspectors carried out a raid on the market.
examples.zh: 稽查人員對那個市場進行了突擊檢查。

examples.en: Officers raided the office to look for missing documents.
examples.zh: 警察突擊搜查辦公室，尋找遺失的文件。

examples.en: The children raided the kitchen for snacks after school.
examples.zh: 孩子們放學後跑去廚房搜刮點心。

examples.en: The inspectors raided the shop for fake goods.
examples.zh: 稽查人員突擊檢查那間店是否販售仿冒品。

examples.en: Hold the rail when you walk down the stairs.
examples.zh: 走下樓梯時請扶好欄杆。

examples.en: The workers replaced a damaged rail before the next train arrived.
examples.zh: 工人在下一班火車抵達前更換了一段受損鐵軌。

examples.en: A towel hung from the rail in the bathroom.
examples.zh: 一條毛巾掛在浴室的橫桿上。

examples.en: Thousands of students joined the rally for clean air.
examples.zh: 數千名學生參加了爭取乾淨空氣的集會。

examples.en: The school held a rally before the big game.
examples.zh: 學校在重要比賽前舉辦了一場造勢大會。

examples.en: Stock prices showed a strong rally this week.
examples.zh: 股價本週出現強勁回升。

examples.en: Neighbors rallied to help the family after the fire.
examples.zh: 火災後，鄰居們集結起來幫助那個家庭。

examples.en: The coach rallied the team at half time.
examples.zh: 教練在中場休息時鼓舞全隊的士氣。

examples.en: The market rallied after the good news.
examples.zh: 市場在好消息公布後出現反彈。

examples.en: My uncle owns a cattle ranch in Texas.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在德州擁有一座養牛的牧場。

examples.en: We spent our summer holiday working on a horse ranch.
examples.zh: 我們暑假在一座養馬的牧場工作。

examples.en: The ranch is a two-hour drive from the city.
examples.zh: 那座牧場離市區有兩小時車程。

examples.en: The teacher chose a random student to answer the question.
examples.zh: 老師隨機挑了一位學生回答問題。

examples.en: A random check of the bags took only a minute.
examples.zh: 隨機抽查袋子只花了一分鐘。

examples.en: She opened the book to a random page and began reading.
examples.zh: 她隨意翻開書中的一頁，開始閱讀。

examples.en: The ratio of boys to girls in our class is one to one.
examples.zh: 我們班男生與女生的比例是一比一。

examples.en: Mix flour and water in a ratio of two to one.
examples.zh: 把麵粉和水以二比一的比例混合。

examples.en: The school hired more teachers to improve its teacher-to-student ratio.
examples.zh: 學校增聘更多教師，以改善師生人數比例。

examples.en: Try to make a rational decision instead of an emotional one.
examples.zh: 試著做出理性的決定，而不是情緒化的決定。

examples.en: There is a rational explanation for the strange noise.
examples.zh: 那個奇怪的聲響有合理的解釋。

examples.en: He stayed calm and rational during the meeting.
examples.zh: 他在會議中保持冷靜且理性。

examples.en: The windows rattle whenever a truck passes by.
examples.zh: 每當卡車經過，窗戶就會嘎嘎作響。

examples.en: The unexpected question rattled the young speaker during her presentation.
examples.zh: 那個突如其來的提問讓年輕講者在簡報時慌了手腳。

examples.en: Coins rattled in the little box on the table.
examples.zh: 桌上的小盒子裡硬幣叮噹作響。

examples.en: We heard the rattle of a loose pipe in the wall.
examples.zh: 我們聽到牆裡鬆脫的管子發出嘎嘎聲。

examples.en: The baby smiled and shook her new rattle.
examples.zh: 寶寶笑著搖著她的新搖鈴。

examples.en: There was a rattle from the back of the old bus.
examples.zh: 那輛老舊公車的後方傳來一陣嘎嘎聲。

examples.en: The painter is famous for the realism of his portraits.
examples.zh: 那位畫家以肖像畫的寫實風格聞名。

examples.en: The film shows the war with great realism.
examples.zh: 這部電影非常寫實地呈現了戰爭。

examples.en: Her realism helped her plan the budget carefully.
examples.zh: 她的務實態度幫助她謹慎地規劃預算。

examples.en: This book explores the realm of space science.
examples.zh: 這本書探討太空科學的領域。

examples.en: Fairy tales often take place in a magical realm.
examples.zh: 童話故事經常發生在一個魔法王國裡。

examples.en: Cooking is outside the realm of my skills.
examples.zh: 烹飪不在我的能力範圍之內。

examples.en: The nurse reassured the child that the shot would be quick.
examples.zh: 護理師安撫那個孩子說打針很快就好。

examples.en: Her smile reassured me before the interview.
examples.zh: 面試前，她的微笑讓我安心不少。

examples.en: The manager reassured customers that the problem would be fixed soon.
examples.zh: 經理向顧客保證問題很快就會修好。

examples.en: The king ended the rebellion without a battle.
examples.zh: 國王沒有開戰就平息了叛亂。

examples.en: Dyeing his hair was a small act of rebellion.
examples.zh: 染髮是他一個小小的叛逆舉動。

examples.en: The teenager's rebellion worried his parents.
examples.zh: 這位青少年的叛逆讓他的父母很擔心。

examples.en: The recipient of the package must sign here.
examples.zh: 包裹的收件人必須在這裡簽名。

examples.en: She was the recipient of the school's top prize.
examples.zh: 她是學校最高獎項的得主。

examples.en: Please write the recipient's address clearly on the envelope.
examples.zh: 請把收件人的地址清楚地寫在信封上。

examples.en: Can you give me a recommendation for a good restaurant?
examples.zh: 你能推薦一家好餐廳給我嗎？

examples.en: The doctor's recommendation was to rest for a week.
examples.zh: 醫生的建議是休息一星期。

examples.en: My teacher wrote a recommendation for my college application.
examples.zh: 我的老師為我的大學申請寫了一封推薦信。

examples.en: The company plans to recruit ten new engineers this year.
examples.zh: 這家公司計劃今年招募十位新工程師。

examples.en: Our club is trying to recruit more members.
examples.zh: 我們社團正努力招募更多成員。

examples.en: The school recruits volunteers every spring to help with sports events.
examples.zh: 學校每年春天都會招募志工，協助舉辦體育活動。

examples.en: Every new recruit gets a short training session.
examples.zh: 每位新進人員都會接受一場簡短的訓練。

examples.en: The team welcomed its newest recruit with a small party.
examples.zh: 團隊辦了個小派對歡迎最新加入的成員。

examples.en: The manager asked a recruit to help with the report.
examples.zh: 經理請一位新進人員協助製作報告。

examples.en: The old church became a refuge for the villagers during the storm.
examples.zh: 風暴期間，那座老教堂成了村民的避難所。

examples.en: The library is my refuge when I need peace and quiet.
examples.zh: 需要安靜時，圖書館是我的避風港。

examples.en: Many birds find refuge in this wetland every winter.
examples.zh: 許多鳥類每年冬天都在這片濕地找到棲身之處。

examples.en: The old regime was replaced after the election.
examples.zh: 舊政權在選舉後被取代了。

examples.en: People living under a strict regime have little freedom.
examples.zh: 生活在嚴格政權下的人們幾乎沒有自由。

examples.en: The doctor put him on a healthy diet regime.
examples.zh: 醫生讓他採用健康的飲食養生法。

examples.en: The workers reinforced the old bridge with steel.
examples.zh: 工人用鋼材加固了那座舊橋。

examples.en: Regular practice will reinforce what you learned in class.
examples.zh: 規律的練習會加強你在課堂上所學。

examples.en: The new data reinforced the scientist's idea.
examples.zh: 新的數據強化了那位科學家的想法。

examples.en: The removal of the old sign took an hour.
examples.zh: 移除舊招牌花了一個小時。

examples.en: The dentist suggested the removal of the bad tooth.
examples.zh: 牙醫建議拔除那顆壞牙。

examples.en: We hired a company to help with the removal of our furniture.
examples.zh: 我們請了一間公司幫忙搬運我們的家具。

examples.en: The heavy rain rendered the road impossible to use.
examples.zh: 大雨使那條路無法通行。

examples.en: The volunteers rendered valuable assistance to families affected by the flood.
examples.zh: 志工們為受水災影響的家庭提供了寶貴的協助。

examples.en: The artist rendered the old bridge in soft colors.
examples.zh: 那位藝術家用柔和的色彩描繪那座古橋。

examples.en: We booked a car rental for our trip to the coast.
examples.zh: 我們為海岸之旅預訂了租車。

examples.en: The monthly rental of this apartment is very high.
examples.zh: 這間公寓的每月租金很高。

examples.en: We returned the rental before noon to avoid paying extra fees.
examples.zh: 我們在中午前歸還租用的物品，以免支付額外費用。

examples.en: We drove a rental car around the island.
examples.zh: 我們開著租來的車環遊全島。

examples.en: The rental office closes at six o'clock.
examples.zh: 租賃辦公室六點關門。

examples.en: She lives in a rental apartment near the school.
examples.zh: 她住在學校附近一間出租公寓。

examples.en: I will repay the money I borrowed by Friday.
examples.zh: 我星期五前會還清借的錢。

examples.en: He repaid her kindness with a small gift.
examples.zh: 他用一份小禮物報答她的好意。

examples.en: It took three years to repay the bank loan.
examples.zh: 償還那筆銀行貸款花了三年。

examples.en: There is a strong resemblance between the two sisters.
examples.zh: 這對姊妹長得非常相像。

examples.en: The toy bears little resemblance to a real train.
examples.zh: 這個玩具跟真正的火車沒什麼相似之處。

examples.en: People often notice her resemblance to her mother.
examples.zh: 人們常常注意到她長得很像她母親。

examples.en: The city gets most of its water from a large reservoir.
examples.zh: 這座城市大部分的水來自一座大水庫。

examples.en: The water level in the reservoir is low this summer.
examples.zh: 今年夏天水庫的水位很低。

examples.en: The library is a reservoir of knowledge for students.
examples.zh: 圖書館是學生的知識寶庫。

examples.en: We live in a quiet residential area near the park.
examples.zh: 我們住在公園附近一個安靜的住宅區。

examples.en: The city banned large trucks from residential streets.
examples.zh: 市政府禁止大卡車進入住宅區街道。

examples.en: The new residential building has forty apartments.
examples.zh: 這棟新的住宅大樓有四十戶公寓。

examples.en: We spent the weekend at a mountain resort.
examples.zh: 我們在一處山區度假村度過週末。

examples.en: The beach resort has three swimming pools.
examples.zh: 這間海灘度假村有三座游泳池。

examples.en: This island is a popular resort for families.
examples.zh: 這座島是受家庭歡迎的度假勝地。

examples.en: Try talking first before you resort to shouting.
examples.zh: 先好好談談，再考慮用大吼的方式。

examples.en: The shop had to resort to selling things online.
examples.zh: 這家店不得不靠在網路上賣東西。

examples.en: Students should not resort to cheating on exams.
examples.zh: 學生不應該靠作弊來應付考試。

examples.en: Classes will resume on Monday after the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期後，課程將在星期一恢復。

examples.en: The train resumed its trip after a short stop.
examples.zh: 火車短暫停靠後繼續前進。

examples.en: We can resume the meeting after lunch.
examples.zh: 我們可以在午餐後繼續開會。

examples.en: She works in retail and sells shoes at a mall.
examples.zh: 她從事零售業，在購物中心賣鞋子。

examples.en: Retail sales rose sharply before the holidays.
examples.zh: 節日前零售銷售量大幅上升。

examples.en: Online shopping has changed the retail industry.
examples.zh: 網路購物改變了零售業。

examples.en: The retail price of this phone is quite high.
examples.zh: 這支手機的零售價格相當高。

examples.en: He opened a small retail store near the station.
examples.zh: 他在車站附近開了一間小型零售店。

examples.en: Retail workers are busy during the sale season.
examples.zh: 零售業員工在特價季期間很忙碌。

examples.en: The company's annual revenue grew by ten percent.
examples.zh: 這間公司的年度營收成長了百分之十。

examples.en: The city earns revenue from parking fees.
examples.zh: 這座城市從停車費中獲得收入。

examples.en: Ticket sales are the main source of revenue for the theater.
examples.zh: 票房是這間劇院的主要收入來源。

examples.en: Please reverse the car slowly into the parking space.
examples.zh: 請慢慢把車倒進停車格。

examples.en: The judge reversed the earlier decision after reviewing new evidence.
examples.zh: 法官審閱新證據後，撤銷了先前的判決。

examples.en: We reversed the order of the two paragraphs.
examples.zh: 我們把這兩個段落的順序對調。

examples.en: The reverse of the coin shows a small tree.
examples.zh: 硬幣的背面刻著一棵小樹。

examples.en: The result was the reverse of what we expected.
examples.zh: 結果與我們預期的相反。

examples.en: Put the car in reverse before you back up.
examples.zh: 倒車前先把車打到倒車檔。

examples.en: The program displays the saved messages in reverse order by date.
examples.zh: 這個程式會按日期倒序顯示已儲存的訊息。

examples.en: The reverse side of the paper is blank.
examples.zh: 這張紙的背面是空白的。

examples.en: Use subtraction as the reverse operation to check your addition.
examples.zh: 用減法作為逆運算，來驗算加法。

examples.en: The speaker used strong rhetoric to move the audience.
examples.zh: 講者運用有力的修辭打動聽眾。

examples.en: He studied rhetoric in college to improve his speeches.
examples.zh: 他在大學學習修辭學來改進演講。

examples.en: Voters were tired of empty rhetoric and wanted real action.
examples.zh: 選民厭倦了空談，想要實際行動。

examples.en: He fell off his bike and broke a rib.
examples.zh: 他從單車上摔下來，斷了一根肋骨。

examples.en: We ordered a plate of pork ribs for dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐點了一盤豬肋排。

examples.en: The doctor pressed gently on my rib to check the pain.
examples.zh: 醫生輕壓我的肋骨檢查疼痛處。

examples.en: We walked along the ridge to enjoy the view.
examples.zh: 我們沿著山脊走，欣賞風景。

examples.en: Clouds covered the ridge in the early morning.
examples.zh: 清晨雲霧籠罩著山脊。

examples.en: A low ridge of snow formed beside the road.
examples.zh: 路邊堆起了一道低矮的雪埂。

examples.en: The plastic is rigid and does not bend easily.
examples.zh: 這種塑膠很硬，不容易彎曲。

examples.en: The school has rigid rules about being on time.
examples.zh: 學校對準時到校有嚴格的規定。

examples.en: My boss is too rigid to try new ideas.
examples.zh: 我的老闆太死板，不願嘗試新點子。

examples.en: Please do not fill the glass above the rim.
examples.zh: 請不要把杯子裝得超過杯緣。

examples.en: The ball bounced off the rim of the basket.
examples.zh: 球從籃框邊彈開了。

examples.en: His glasses have a thin black rim.
examples.zh: 他的眼鏡有細細的黑色鏡框。

examples.en: The city was quiet again after the riot ended.
examples.zh: 暴動結束後，城市又恢復了平靜。

examples.en: A riot broke out at the stadium after the match.
examples.zh: 比賽結束後，體育場發生了騷亂。

examples.en: The news report showed damage from last night's riot.
examples.zh: 新聞報導呈現了昨晚暴動造成的損害。

examples.en: Fans rioted outside the stadium after the loss.
examples.zh: 球迷在輸球後於體育場外鬧事。

examples.en: People rioted in the streets when prices suddenly rose.
examples.zh: 物價突然上漲時，民眾在街頭暴動。

examples.en: The prisoners rioted over the poor food.
examples.zh: 囚犯因伙食太差而騷動。

examples.en: Be careful not to rip the page when you turn it.
examples.zh: 翻頁時小心別把紙撕破。

examples.en: She ripped open the envelope and read the letter.
examples.zh: 她撕開信封讀了信。

examples.en: The nail ripped a hole in my sleeve.
examples.zh: 釘子把我的袖子劃破了一個洞。

examples.en: There is a long rip in the bottom of the bag.
examples.zh: 袋子底部有一道很長的裂口。

examples.en: I need to sew up the rip in my jeans.
examples.zh: 我得把牛仔褲上的破洞縫起來。

examples.en: The tent has a small rip near the door.
examples.zh: 帳篷門口附近有一個小破洞。

examples.en: Swimming in the river after the storm is risky.
examples.zh: 暴風雨過後在河裡游泳很危險。

examples.en: Investing all your money in one company is risky.
examples.zh: 把所有的錢都投資在一家公司是有風險的。

examples.en: It is risky to cross the road without looking.
examples.zh: 沒看路就過馬路很危險。

examples.en: The villagers perform a ritual to welcome the new year.
examples.zh: 村民舉行儀式迎接新年。

examples.en: Drinking tea after dinner is a family ritual.
examples.zh: 晚餐後喝茶是一種家庭慣例。

examples.en: The graduation ritual includes a short speech and a song.
examples.zh: 畢業典禮儀式包括一段簡短的演講和一首歌。

examples.en: The temple holds a ritual dance every spring.
examples.zh: 廟裡每年春天都會舉行儀式舞蹈。

examples.en: They followed a ritual practice passed down for years.
examples.zh: 他們遵循一項流傳多年的儀式習俗。

examples.en: A ritual bath is part of the ceremony.
examples.zh: 沐浴淨身是這個典禮的一部分。

examples.en: The mountain is sacred to the local people.
examples.zh: 這座山對當地人來說是神聖的。

examples.en: Visitors must be quiet inside the sacred temple.
examples.zh: 訪客在神聖的寺廟內必須保持安靜。

examples.en: Family dinners are sacred in our house.
examples.zh: 在我們家，全家吃晚餐是神聖不可侵犯的事。

examples.en: The rider put a saddle on the horse.
examples.zh: 騎士替馬裝上了馬鞍。

examples.en: I lowered the saddle so my feet could reach the ground.
examples.zh: 我把座墊調低，這樣腳才碰得到地面。

examples.en: The leather saddle was old but still comfortable.
examples.zh: 這個皮製馬鞍雖然舊了，但還是很舒服。

examples.en: He saddled the horse before the morning ride.
examples.zh: 他在早晨騎馬前替馬裝上鞍。

examples.en: The loan saddled the family with heavy debt.
examples.zh: 那筆貸款讓這個家庭背上沉重的債務。

examples.en: Don't saddle yourself with too many tasks.
examples.zh: 不要讓自己扛太多工作。

examples.en: The church was named after a famous saint.
examples.zh: 這座教堂是以一位著名的聖人命名的。

examples.en: People say she is a saint because she helps everyone.
examples.zh: 大家都說她是聖人，因為她樂於幫助每個人。

examples.en: A statue of the saint stands in the town square.
examples.zh: 那位聖人的雕像矗立在鎮上的廣場。

examples.en: We had grilled salmon with rice for dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐吃了烤鮭魚配白飯。

examples.en: Salmon swim up the river to lay their eggs.
examples.zh: 鮭魚會逆流游上河川去產卵。

examples.en: He bought fresh salmon at the market this morning.
examples.zh: 他今早在市場買了新鮮的鮭魚。

examples.en: She painted her room a soft salmon color.
examples.zh: 她把房間漆成柔和的鮭魚粉橘色。

examples.en: The salmon sunset lit up the whole sky.
examples.zh: 鮭魚色的夕陽照亮了整片天空。

examples.en: He wore a salmon shirt to the party.
examples.zh: 他穿了一件粉橘色的襯衫去參加派對。

examples.en: She made an appointment at the hair salon.
examples.zh: 她預約了美髮沙龍。

examples.en: The nail salon opens at ten o'clock.
examples.zh: 美甲沙龍十點開門。

examples.en: My aunt runs a small beauty salon downtown.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在市區經營一間小型美容院。

examples.en: I wore sandals to the beach because it was hot.
examples.zh: 天氣很熱，所以我穿涼鞋去海邊。

examples.en: She bought a pair of leather sandals for the summer.
examples.zh: 她為夏天買了一雙皮涼鞋。

examples.en: One of my sandals broke while I was walking.
examples.zh: 我走路時有一隻涼鞋壞掉了。

examples.en: The mayor resigned because of a money scandal.
examples.zh: 市長因為一樁金錢醜聞而辭職。

examples.en: The news about the scandal spread quickly online.
examples.zh: 這則醜聞的消息在網路上迅速傳開。

examples.en: The company tried to hide the scandal from the public.
examples.zh: 那間公司試圖向大眾隱瞞這樁醜聞。

examples.en: He has a small scar on his chin from a fall.
examples.zh: 他下巴上有一道摔倒留下的小疤。

examples.en: The surgery left a long scar on her arm.
examples.zh: 那次手術在她的手臂上留下一道長疤。

examples.en: The war left deep scars on the town.
examples.zh: 戰爭在這座小鎮留下了深深的傷痕。

examples.en: The burn scarred his hand for life.
examples.zh: 那次燙傷讓他的手留下終生的疤痕。

examples.en: The accident scarred her for a long time.
examples.zh: 那次意外在她心中留下了長久的陰影。

examples.en: The sharp tool scarred the surface of the wooden table.
examples.zh: 銳利的工具在木桌表面留下了刮痕。

examples.en: In the worst scenario, the flight will be canceled.
examples.zh: 在最糟的情況下，班機會被取消。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a scenario and asked us to role-play it.
examples.zh: 老師給了我們一個情境，要我們進行角色扮演。

examples.en: The manager prepared a plan for each possible scenario.
examples.zh: 經理為每一種可能的情況都準備了計畫。

examples.en: The scent of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
examples.zh: 剛出爐麵包的香味瀰漫整間廚房。

examples.en: This soap has a light lemon scent.
examples.zh: 這塊香皂有淡淡的檸檬香味。

examples.en: Dogs can follow a scent for many miles.
examples.zh: 狗可以循著氣味追蹤好幾英里。

examples.en: The scope of this project is quite wide.
examples.zh: 這個專案的範圍相當廣。

examples.en: The assignment gives students plenty of scope for creative thinking.
examples.zh: 這份作業讓學生有充分發揮創意思考的空間。

examples.en: Our report has a limited scope because of the short deadline.
examples.zh: 由於期限很短，我們的報告範圍有限。

examples.en: The kids scrambled up the hill to get a better view.
examples.zh: 孩子們手腳並用爬上山丘，想要有更好的視野。

examples.en: Fans scrambled for the best seats in the hall.
examples.zh: 粉絲們爭搶大廳裡最好的座位。

examples.en: Please scramble the eggs with a little milk.
examples.zh: 請加一點牛奶來炒蛋。

examples.en: There was a scramble for tickets when the sale began.
examples.zh: 開始販售時，大家爭搶著買票。

examples.en: The morning was a scramble to get everyone out the door.
examples.zh: 那天早上為了讓大家出門，忙成一團。

examples.en: The steep scramble up the hillside took us an hour.
examples.zh: 我們花了一個小時手腳並用爬上陡峭山坡。

examples.en: She wrote the phone number on a scrap of paper.
examples.zh: 她把電話號碼寫在一小張碎紙上。

examples.en: The shop sells scrap metal to a recycling plant.
examples.zh: 這家店把廢金屬賣給回收工廠。

examples.en: There was not a scrap of food left in the fridge.
examples.zh: 冰箱裡一點食物也不剩。

examples.en: The city decided to scrap the old bus line.
examples.zh: 市政府決定廢除舊的公車路線。

examples.en: We had to scrap our travel plans because of the storm.
examples.zh: 因為暴風雨，我們只好取消旅行計畫。

examples.en: The company will scrap the old machines next month.
examples.zh: 公司下個月將報廢那些舊機器。

examples.en: The actors practiced their lines from the script.
examples.zh: 演員們照著劇本練習台詞。

examples.en: He wrote a short script for the school video.
examples.zh: 他為學校的影片寫了一份簡短的腳本。

examples.en: Her script is neat and easy to read.
examples.zh: 她的字跡工整，很好讀。

examples.en: The first segment of the show was about cooking.
examples.zh: 節目的第一個單元是關於烹飪。

examples.en: Each segment of the orange was sweet and juicy.
examples.zh: 這顆柳橙的每一瓣都香甜多汁。

examples.en: This segment of the road is closed for repairs.
examples.zh: 這一段道路因維修而封閉。

examples.en: I will attend a seminar on healthy eating tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我明天要參加一場關於健康飲食的研討會。

examples.en: The professor leads a small seminar for graduate students.
examples.zh: 教授帶領一個研究生的小型討論課。

examples.en: The company holds a training seminar every spring.
examples.zh: 公司每年春天都會舉辦教育訓練研討會。

examples.en: The senator gave a speech about education.
examples.zh: 那位參議員發表了關於教育的演說。

examples.en: Our class wrote a letter to the senator.
examples.zh: 我們班寫了一封信給那位參議員。

examples.en: She was elected senator at the age of forty.
examples.zh: 她四十歲時當選參議員。

senses.zh: 感覺；轟動一時的人事物

examples.en: I felt a tingling sensation in my fingers.
examples.zh: 我覺得手指有刺麻的感覺。

examples.en: The new singer became an overnight sensation.
examples.zh: 這位新歌手一夕之間爆紅。

examples.en: The cold water gave her a pleasant sensation.
examples.zh: 冰涼的水讓她覺得很舒服。

examples.en: Her sensitivity to light makes it hard to drive at night.
examples.zh: 她對光線很敏感，所以夜間開車很困難。

examples.en: The teacher handled the topic with great sensitivity.
examples.zh: 老師以非常體貼的態度處理這個話題。

examples.en: He has a sensitivity to certain kinds of nuts.
examples.zh: 他對某些種類的堅果有敏感反應。

examples.en: Many people share the same sentiment about the new rule.
examples.zh: 許多人對這項新規定有相同的看法。

examples.en: The card expressed a warm sentiment.
examples.zh: 這張卡片表達了溫暖的情感。

examples.en: Public sentiment turned against the plan last week.
examples.zh: 上週輿論轉而反對這項計畫。

examples.en: My grandmother is sentimental about old photos.
examples.zh: 我奶奶對老照片很有感情。

examples.en: He kept the ticket for sentimental reasons.
examples.zh: 他因情感上的因素而留著那張票。

examples.en: The movie was too sentimental for my taste.
examples.zh: 這部電影對我來說太煽情了。

examples.en: Please put the pictures in the correct sequence.
examples.zh: 請把這些圖片按正確順序排好。

examples.en: The film begins with a sequence of fast scenes.
examples.zh: 這部電影以一連串快速的畫面開場。

examples.en: Follow the steps in this sequence to set up the printer.
examples.zh: 請照這個順序操作來安裝印表機。

examples.en: The website was down because the server crashed.
examples.zh: 網站因為伺服器當機而無法使用。

examples.en: Our server brought us water and a menu.
examples.zh: 我們的服務生送來了水和菜單。

examples.en: The school keeps all its files on a central server.
examples.zh: 學校把所有檔案都存放在一台中央伺服器上。

examples.en: The cabin is in a quiet setting near the lake.
examples.zh: 這間小木屋位於湖邊安靜的環境中。

examples.en: The story has a small town as its setting.
examples.zh: 這個故事以一座小鎮為背景。

examples.en: Change the setting on your phone to save battery.
examples.zh: 請更改手機的設定來省電。

examples.en: Each shareholder received a letter from the company.
examples.zh: 每位股東都收到了公司寄來的信。

examples.en: The largest shareholder voted against the plan.
examples.zh: 最大的股東投票反對這項計畫。

examples.en: Shareholders will meet in March to discuss profits.
examples.zh: 股東們將在三月開會討論獲利。

examples.en: The glass fell and shattered on the kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 玻璃杯掉到廚房地板上摔碎了。

examples.en: A loud noise shattered the quiet of the library.
examples.zh: 一聲巨響打破了圖書館的寧靜。

examples.en: The bad news shattered her hopes of winning.
examples.zh: 這個壞消息粉碎了她獲勝的希望。

examples.en: Dad keeps the garden tools in the shed.
examples.zh: 爸爸把園藝工具放在棚屋裡。

examples.en: The bikes are parked in a shed behind the house.
examples.zh: 腳踏車停放在房子後面的棚子裡。

examples.en: We built a small shed for firewood.
examples.zh: 我們搭了一個小棚子來放柴火。

examples.en: She shed tears of joy when her daughter graduated.
examples.zh: 女兒畢業時，她流下喜悅的淚水。

examples.en: Our dog sheds hair all year round.
examples.zh: 我們家的狗一年到頭都在掉毛。

examples.en: The new law may shed light on the problem.
examples.zh: 這項新法律或許能讓問題更明朗。

examples.en: The sheer size of the building surprised us.
examples.zh: 這棟建築物的龐大程度讓我們很驚訝。

examples.en: The cliff is sheer, so hikers must be careful.
examples.zh: 那道懸崖很陡峭，登山客必須小心。

examples.en: She wore a sheer scarf over her shoulders.
examples.zh: 她肩上披著一條薄紗圍巾。

examples.en: The sheriff drove around the small town every morning.
examples.zh: 警長每天早上都開車巡視這個小鎮。

examples.en: The sheriff helped the lost child find her parents.
examples.zh: 警長幫迷路的小女孩找到她的父母。

examples.en: In the old movie, the sheriff wore a silver badge.
examples.zh: 在那部老電影裡，警長戴著一枚銀色徽章。

examples.en: The knight held a heavy shield in his left hand.
examples.zh: 騎士左手拿著一面沉重的盾牌。

examples.en: Trees act as a shield against the strong wind.
examples.zh: 樹木可以擋住強風。

examples.en: Wear a face shield when you cut the metal.
examples.zh: 切割金屬時請戴上護面罩。

examples.en: She raised her hand to shield her eyes from the sun.
examples.zh: 她舉起手遮住眼睛，擋住陽光。

examples.en: Parents try to shield their children from danger.
examples.zh: 父母會設法保護孩子遠離危險。

examples.en: The umbrella will shield you from the rain.
examples.zh: 這把傘可以幫你擋雨。

examples.en: The children shivered in the cold wind.
examples.zh: 孩子們在冷風中發抖。

examples.en: I shiver whenever I walk into the freezer.
examples.zh: 每次走進冷凍庫，我都會打哆嗦。

examples.en: He shivered with fear during the scary movie.
examples.zh: 他看恐怖電影時嚇得發抖。

examples.en: A shiver ran down my back when the lights went out.
examples.zh: 燈光熄滅時，我的背脊竄過一陣顫慄。

examples.en: She felt a shiver of excitement before the show.
examples.zh: 表演開始前，她感到一陣興奮的顫抖。

examples.en: The cold water sent a shiver through him.
examples.zh: 冰冷的水讓他打了個冷顫。

examples.en: Please do not shove other people on the bus.
examples.zh: 請不要在公車上推擠別人。

examples.en: He shoved his books into the bag and ran out.
examples.zh: 他把書塞進書包就跑了出去。

examples.en: The workers shoved the heavy box across the floor.
examples.zh: 工人們把沉重的箱子推過地板。

examples.en: The crowd gave me a shove toward the exit.
examples.zh: 人群推了我一把，讓我往出口走去。

examples.en: With one shove, the door opened.
examples.zh: 用力一推，門就開了。

examples.en: She gave the stuck drawer a hard shove.
examples.zh: 她用力推了一下卡住的抽屜。

examples.en: Do you have any siblings who go to this school?
examples.zh: 你有兄弟姊妹也在這所學校就讀嗎？

examples.en: My sibling and I share a room.
examples.zh: 我和我的手足共用一間房間。

examples.en: Siblings often argue but still care about each other.
examples.zh: 兄弟姊妹常常吵架，但仍然互相關心。

examples.en: The old castle survived a long siege.
examples.zh: 那座古老的城堡撐過了漫長的圍困。

examples.en: The museum tells the story of the siege of the city.
examples.zh: 博物館介紹了這座城市被圍困的歷史。

examples.en: The town was under siege for three months.
examples.zh: 這座城鎮被圍困了三個月。

examples.en: The museum has a dinosaur skeleton in the main hall.
examples.zh: 博物館的大廳裡有一具恐龍骨架。

examples.en: The human skeleton has more than two hundred bones.
examples.zh: 人體骨骼有兩百多塊骨頭。

examples.en: The skeleton of the new building is already standing.
examples.zh: 這棟新大樓的骨架已經立起來了。

examples.en: Don't slam the door when the baby is sleeping.
examples.zh: 嬰兒在睡覺時，不要用力甩門。

examples.en: He slammed his bag on the desk and sat down.
examples.zh: 他把書包重重放在桌上，然後坐了下來。

examples.en: The wind slammed the window shut while we were eating dinner.
examples.zh: 我們正在吃晚餐時，風把窗戶砰地吹上。

examples.en: We heard the slam of a car door outside.
examples.zh: 我們聽到外面一聲重重的關車門聲。

examples.en: The slam woke everyone in the house.
examples.zh: 那聲巨響吵醒了全家人。

examples.en: There was a loud slam from the kitchen.
examples.zh: 廚房傳來砰的一聲巨響。

examples.en: She slapped the mosquito on her arm.
examples.zh: 她拍了一下手臂上的蚊子。

examples.en: He slapped the money on the counter and left.
examples.zh: 他把錢啪地放在櫃檯上就離開了。

examples.en: The waves slapped against the side of the boat.
examples.zh: 海浪拍打著船身。

examples.en: The wet towel hit the floor with a slap.
examples.zh: 濕毛巾啪的一聲掉到地上。

examples.en: He gave his friend a friendly slap on the back.
examples.zh: 他友善地拍了朋友的背一下。

examples.en: I heard the slap of feet on the wet floor.
examples.zh: 我聽到腳踩在濕地板上的啪啪聲。

examples.en: Put a coin in the slot to start the machine.
examples.zh: 把硬幣投進投幣孔來啟動機器。

examples.en: She dropped the letter through the slot in the door.
examples.zh: 她把信從門上的投信口投了進去。

examples.en: We have a time slot open on Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們週五下午有一個空檔時段。

examples.en: Slot the card into the reader and wait.
examples.zh: 把卡片插入讀卡機，然後等一下。

examples.en: He slotted the last piece into the puzzle.
examples.zh: 他把最後一片拼圖放進去。

examples.en: The shelves slot together without any tools.
examples.zh: 這些層架不用工具就能組合起來。

examples.en: The ball smashed the window of the classroom.
examples.zh: 球打破了教室的窗戶。

examples.en: The car smashed into a wall near the school.
examples.zh: 那輛車猛撞上學校旁的一道牆。

examples.en: Careful, or you will smash the plates.
examples.zh: 小心點，不然你會把盤子打碎。

examples.en: Her first novel was a smash with young readers.
examples.zh: 她的第一本小說大受年輕讀者歡迎。

examples.en: We heard the smash of glass in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我們聽到廚房傳來玻璃碎裂的聲音。

examples.en: The new game was a smash hit this summer.
examples.zh: 這款新遊戲今年夏天大受歡迎。

examples.en: The bird snatched the bread from my hand.
examples.zh: 那隻鳥從我手中一把叼走麵包。

examples.en: He snatched his coat and ran for the bus.
examples.zh: 他抓起外套，衝去趕公車。

examples.en: A thief tried to snatch her bag at the station.
examples.zh: 有小偷想在車站搶走她的包包。

examples.en: I heard a snatch of music from the next room.
examples.zh: 我聽到隔壁房間傳來一小段音樂。

examples.en: She caught a snatch of their talk on the train.
examples.zh: 她在火車上聽到他們談話的片段。

examples.en: He read a snatch of the poem aloud.
examples.zh: 他大聲朗讀了那首詩的幾句。

examples.en: The dog sniffed the bag for food.
examples.zh: 狗用鼻子聞那個袋子，想找食物。

examples.en: She sniffed the milk to see if it was fresh.
examples.zh: 她聞了聞牛奶，看看是不是新鮮的。

examples.en: He sniffed and wiped his nose with a tissue.
examples.zh: 他吸了吸鼻子，用面紙擦鼻涕。

examples.en: The cat took a sniff of the fish.
examples.zh: 貓聞了一下那條魚。

examples.en: I heard a loud sniff from the back row.
examples.zh: 我聽到後排傳來很大的吸鼻子聲。

examples.en: Take a sniff of this soup and tell me what you think.
examples.zh: 聞聞看這碗湯，告訴我你的感覺。

examples.en: Soak the beans in water overnight before cooking them for soup.
examples.zh: 煮湯前，先把豆子泡在水裡一整夜。

examples.en: The rain soaked my shoes on the way home.
examples.zh: 回家的路上，雨把我的鞋子淋得濕透了。

examples.en: She soaked her feet in warm water after the hike.
examples.zh: 健行後，她把雙腳泡在溫水裡。

examples.en: The eagle soared high above the mountains.
examples.zh: 老鷹在群山上方翱翔。

examples.en: Prices soared after the storm hit the farms.
examples.zh: 暴風雨襲擊農場後，物價飆漲。

examples.en: Her spirits soared when she heard the good news.
examples.zh: 聽到好消息時，她的心情高昂起來。

senses.zh: 未喝醉的；嚴肅的；樸素的

examples.en: He stayed sober because he had to drive home.
examples.zh: 他因為要開車回家，所以一直保持清醒。

examples.en: The doctor gave us a sober report on his health.
examples.zh: 醫生向我們提供了關於他健康狀況的嚴肅報告。

examples.en: She chose a sober gray suit for the interview.
examples.zh: 她選了一套樸素的灰色套裝去面試。

examples.en: Heat the butter to soften it before adding the flour.
examples.zh: 加入麵粉前，先加熱奶油使它軟化。

examples.en: The lamp softens the light in the room.
examples.zh: 這盞燈讓房間裡的光線變柔和。

examples.en: A kind smile can soften an angry face.
examples.zh: 親切的微笑可以讓憤怒的臉龐緩和下來。

examples.en: She was the sole winner of the contest.

examples.en: The city ended the subsidy for electric scooters last year.
examples.zh: 市政府去年停止了電動機車的補助。

examples.en: The company made a substantial profit this year.
examples.zh: 公司今年賺進了可觀的利潤。

examples.en: A substantial number of students joined the club.
examples.zh: 有相當多的學生加入了這個社團。

examples.en: We had a substantial breakfast before the hike.
examples.zh: 我們在健行前吃了一頓豐盛的早餐。

examples.en: There is a subtle difference between these two colors.
examples.zh: 這兩種顏色之間有細微的差別。

examples.en: She gave him a subtle hint that it was time to go.
examples.zh: 她給了他一個微妙的暗示，表示該走了。

examples.en: The soup has a subtle flavor of ginger.
examples.zh: 這碗湯有淡淡的薑味。

examples.en: They live in a quiet suburban neighborhood.
examples.zh: 他們住在安靜的郊區社區。

examples.en: Many suburban families own two cars for commuting to different workplaces.
examples.zh: 許多郊區家庭擁有兩輛車，用來通勤到不同的工作地點。

examples.en: We moved to a suburban area to be closer to the park.
examples.zh: 我們搬到了郊區，離公園近一點。

examples.en: The manager is looking for a successor before she retires.
examples.zh: 經理在退休前正在尋找接任者。

examples.en: The new phone is the successor to last year's model.
examples.zh: 這支新手機是去年款式的後續機種。

examples.en: Who will be the successor of the club president?
examples.zh: 誰會接任社團社長？

examples.en: We booked a suite with an ocean view.
examples.zh: 我們訂了一間有海景的套房。

examples.en: The orchestra played a suite based on traditional folk songs.
examples.zh: 管弦樂團演奏了一首以傳統民謠為基礎的組曲。

examples.en: The office suite includes a word processor and a spreadsheet program.
examples.zh: 這套辦公室軟體包含文書處理程式和試算表程式。

examples.en: It is a common superstition that the number four is unlucky.
examples.zh: 數字四不吉利是一種常見的迷信。

examples.en: My grandmother believes in many old superstitions.
examples.zh: 我奶奶相信許多古老的迷信。

examples.en: Superstition makes some people avoid walking under ladders.
examples.zh: 迷信讓有些人避免從梯子底下走過。

examples.en: Teachers supervise the students during lunch to ensure everyone behaves properly.
examples.zh: 午餐時間老師會看管學生，確保大家行為合宜。

examples.en: She supervises a team of ten workers.
examples.zh: 她管理一個十人的團隊。

examples.en: A parent must supervise young children at the pool.
examples.zh: 家長必須在泳池邊看管年幼的孩子。

examples.en: Young children need adult supervision near the water.
examples.zh: 年幼的孩子在水邊需要大人看管。

examples.en: The students worked in the lab under the teacher's supervision.
examples.zh: 學生們在老師的督導下於實驗室裡工作。

examples.en: The new employees are working under close supervision.
examples.zh: 新進員工正在嚴密的督導下工作。

examples.en: The company reported a surplus at the end of the year.
examples.zh: 公司在年底公布了盈餘。

examples.en: The farm has a surplus of rice this season.
examples.zh: 這座農場這一季的稻米過剩。

examples.en: The city donated its food surplus to families in need.
examples.zh: 市政府把剩餘的食物捐給有需要的家庭。

examples.en: We donated our surplus clothes to a charity.
examples.zh: 我們把多餘的衣服捐給了慈善機構。

examples.en: The shop sells surplus goods at half price.
examples.zh: 這家店以半價出售剩餘的貨品。

examples.en: Use the surplus water to wash the car.
examples.zh: 把多餘的水拿來洗車。

examples.en: The mall uses cameras for surveillance to help prevent theft.
examples.zh: 這間購物中心使用攝影機進行監視，以協助預防竊盜。

examples.en: The building is under 24-hour surveillance to protect the valuable equipment inside.
examples.zh: 這棟大樓全天候受到監視，以保護裡面的貴重設備。

examples.en: Police reviewed the surveillance footage from the station.
examples.zh: 警方調閱了車站的監視影像。

examples.en: Plants need water and sunlight to sustain growth.
examples.zh: 植物需要水和陽光來維持生長。

examples.en: The old bridge cannot sustain heavy trucks.
examples.zh: 這座舊橋無法承受重型卡車。

examples.en: She sustained a minor injury during the game.
examples.zh: 她在比賽中受了輕傷。

examples.en: The city is building a sustainable transport system.
examples.zh: 這座城市正在建立永續的交通系統。

examples.en: Bamboo is a sustainable material for furniture.
examples.zh: 竹子是適合做家具的永續材料。

examples.en: We should find a sustainable way to use water.
examples.zh: 我們應該找到永續利用水資源的方法。

examples.en: Let's swap seats so you can see the screen.
examples.zh: 我們交換座位吧，這樣你就能看到螢幕。

examples.en: The two students swapped notebooks before the quiz.
examples.zh: 兩位學生在小考前互換了筆記本。

examples.en: Can I swap my shift with yours on Friday?
examples.zh: 星期五我可以和你換班嗎？

examples.en: The class held a book swap last week.
examples.zh: 班上上週舉辦了一場書籍交換活動。

examples.en: We made a quick swap of phone numbers.
examples.zh: 我們很快互換了電話號碼。

examples.en: The two teams agreed to a player swap.
examples.zh: 兩支球隊同意了球員交換。

examples.en: The dove is symbolic of peace in many cultures.
examples.zh: 鴿子在許多文化中象徵和平。

examples.en: The mayor made a symbolic visit to the old school.
examples.zh: 市長象徵性地拜訪了那所老學校。

examples.en: Red is a symbolic color for good luck in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 在台灣，紅色是象徵好運的顏色。

examples.en: The doctor explained the syndrome to the patient's parents.
examples.zh: 醫師向病人的父母說明了這種症候群。

examples.en: Down syndrome is a condition that a child is born with.
examples.zh: 唐氏症是孩子與生俱來的一種狀況。

examples.en: Carpal tunnel syndrome can cause numbness and tingling in the hand.
examples.zh: 腕隧道症候群可能造成手部麻木和刺痛。

examples.en: We need to tackle this problem as a team.
examples.zh: 我們需要以團隊合作來處理這個問題。

examples.en: The city is trying to tackle traffic jams.
examples.zh: 市政府正試圖解決塞車問題。

examples.en: The player tackled his opponent and took the ball.
examples.zh: 那位球員擒抱對手並搶下了球。

examples.en: My uncle keeps his fishing tackle in the garage.
examples.zh: 我叔叔把他的釣具放在車庫裡。

examples.en: The coach praised him for a clean tackle.
examples.zh: 教練稱讚他那次乾淨的擒抱。

examples.en: Bring all your fishing tackle to the lake.
examples.zh: 把你所有的釣具帶去湖邊。

examples.en: The coach changed his tactic in the second half.
examples.zh: 教練在下半場改變了戰術。

examples.en: Offering discounts is a common sales tactic.
examples.zh: 提供折扣是常見的銷售手法。

examples.en: Her tactic was to stay calm and listen first.
examples.zh: 她的策略是保持冷靜並先聽對方說。

examples.en: My earphones were in a tangle at the bottom of the bag.
examples.zh: 我的耳機纏成一團，躺在包包底部。

examples.en: She brushed the tangle out of her long hair.
examples.zh: 她把長髮上的糾結梳開。

examples.en: The room was a tangle of wires and cables.
examples.zh: 房間裡電線和纜線糾纏成一團。

examples.en: The kitten tangled itself in the yarn.
examples.zh: 小貓把自己纏進毛線裡了。

examples.en: Strong wind can tangle your hair.
examples.zh: 強風會把你的頭髮吹亂打結。

examples.en: Fishing lines tangle easily if you don't store them properly.
examples.zh: 釣魚線如果沒有妥善收好，很容易打結。

examples.en: The smell of fresh bread always tempts me to buy a loaf.
examples.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味總是讓我忍不住想買一條。

examples.en: Don't let a low price tempt you into buying something you don't need.
examples.zh: 別讓低價誘使你買下不需要的東西。

examples.en: The sunny weather tempted us to skip class and go to the beach.
examples.zh: 晴朗的天氣讓我們想翹課去海邊。

examples.en: I couldn't resist the temptation to check my phone during the movie.
examples.zh: 看電影時，我抵擋不住誘惑，查看了手機。

examples.en: A box of chocolates on the desk is a big temptation for me.
examples.zh: 桌上的一盒巧克力對我來說是很大的誘惑。

examples.en: He gave in to temptation and ate the last piece of cake.
examples.zh: 他抵擋不住誘惑，吃掉了最後一塊蛋糕。

examples.en: The witness will testify in court on Monday morning.
examples.zh: 這位證人星期一早上會出庭作證。

examples.en: Several neighbors testified that they had seen him at home that night.
examples.zh: 幾位鄰居作證說，他們那晚看到他在家。

examples.en: Her success testifies to years of hard work.
examples.zh: 她的成功證明了多年的努力。

examples.en: This sweater has a soft texture that feels nice on the skin.
examples.zh: 這件毛衣質地柔軟，穿在身上很舒服。

examples.en: I like the creamy texture of this ice cream.
examples.zh: 我喜歡這種冰淇淋綿密的口感。

examples.en: The artist used paint to give the wall a rough texture.
examples.zh: 藝術家用顏料讓牆面呈現粗糙的質感。

examples.en: The class focuses on theoretical knowledge rather than practical skills.
examples.zh: 這堂課著重理論知識，而不是實務技能。

examples.en: There is a theoretical chance that the plan could work.
examples.zh: 這個計畫理論上有可能成功。

examples.en: He has a strong theoretical background in physics.
examples.zh: 他在物理方面有深厚的理論基礎。

examples.en: My sister works as a physical therapist at a local hospital.
examples.zh: 我姊姊在當地醫院擔任物理治療師。

examples.en: She talks to a therapist once a week to manage stress.
examples.zh: 她每週找心理治療師談一次話來紓解壓力。

examples.en: The therapist taught him some exercises for his sore back.
examples.zh: 治療師教了他一些緩解背痛的運動。

examples.en: She saved money every month, thereby paying off her debt early.
examples.zh: 她每個月都存錢，因而提早還清了債務。

examples.en: The company cut its costs, thereby increasing its profits.
examples.zh: 公司降低成本，藉此提高了利潤。

examples.en: He practiced often, thereby improving his English speaking skills.
examples.zh: 他經常練習，因而提升了英語口說能力。

examples.en: She is writing her master's thesis on climate change.
examples.zh: 她正在寫關於氣候變遷的碩士論文。

examples.en: The professor asked him to defend his thesis in front of the committee.
examples.zh: 教授要求他在委員會面前為論文答辯。

examples.en: The main thesis of the article is that sleep improves memory.
examples.zh: 這篇文章的主要論點是睡眠能增進記憶力。

examples.en: He hurt his thigh while playing basketball.
examples.zh: 他打籃球時傷到了大腿。

examples.en: Squats are a good exercise for strengthening your thighs.
examples.zh: 深蹲是強化大腿的好運動。

examples.en: The baby sat on her mother's thigh and laughed.
examples.zh: 小嬰兒坐在媽媽的大腿上笑著。

examples.en: The little girl stood at the threshold and waved goodbye.
examples.zh: 小女孩站在門口揮手道別。

examples.en: You must earn above a certain threshold to apply for this program.
examples.zh: 你的收入必須超過一定門檻才能申請這個計畫。

examples.en: The company is on the threshold of a major change.
examples.zh: 這家公司正處於重大轉變的臨界點。

examples.en: Riding the roller coaster gave the kids a big thrill.
examples.zh: 搭雲霄飛車讓孩子們感到非常興奮。

examples.en: She felt a thrill when she heard her name called.
examples.zh: 聽到自己的名字被叫到時，她感到一陣興奮。

examples.en: For many travelers, the thrill of discovering a new place is worth the trip.
examples.zh: 對許多旅客來說，探索新地方的刺激感值得這趟旅程。

examples.en: The magic show thrilled the young audience.
examples.zh: 魔術表演讓年輕的觀眾非常興奮。

examples.en: The news of the victory thrilled the whole school.
examples.zh: 勝利的消息讓全校都很激動。

examples.en: It thrills me to see my students make progress.
examples.zh: 看到學生進步讓我很興奮。

examples.en: We watched a thriller on Friday night and couldn't sleep.
examples.zh: 我們星期五晚上看了一部驚悚片，結果睡不著。

examples.en: This thriller is so exciting that I finished it in one day.
examples.zh: 這本懸疑小說太精采，我一天就看完了。

examples.en: She enjoys reading a good thriller on long flights.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在長途飛行時閱讀一本好看的懸疑小說。

examples.en: These plants thrive in warm and sunny places.
examples.zh: 這些植物在溫暖又向陽的地方長得很好。

examples.en: Small businesses can thrive when the community supports them.
examples.zh: 當社區支持時，小型商店也能蓬勃發展。

examples.en: Many children thrive when they receive enough love and attention.
examples.zh: 許多孩子在得到足夠的關愛與關注時會健康成長。

examples.en: The king sat on his golden throne and spoke to the crowd.
examples.zh: 國王坐在金色的寶座上對群眾說話。

examples.en: The young prince will take the throne next year.
examples.zh: 年輕的王子明年將登上王位。

examples.en: Visitors can see the royal throne in the museum.
examples.zh: 遊客可以在博物館裡看到皇家寶座。

examples.en: She thrust the letter into my hand and hurried away.
examples.zh: 她把信塞進我手裡就匆匆離開了。

examples.en: The boy thrust his hands into his pockets because it was cold.
examples.zh: 天氣很冷，男孩把雙手插進口袋裡。

examples.en: He thrust the door open and ran into the classroom.
examples.zh: 他用力推開門，跑進了教室。

examples.en: The thrust of the engine pushes the plane forward.
examples.zh: 引擎的推力讓飛機向前飛行。

examples.en: The main thrust of her speech was about saving energy.
examples.zh: 她演講的主旨是關於節約能源。

examples.en: The rocket needs enough thrust to leave the ground.
examples.zh: 火箭需要足夠的推力才能離開地面。

examples.en: I could hear the tick of the clock in the quiet room.
examples.zh: 在安靜的房間裡，我聽得到時鐘的滴答聲。

examples.en: Please put a tick next to each task you have finished.
examples.zh: 請在你完成的每件事旁打勾。

examples.en: The vet found a tick on the dog's ear.
examples.zh: 獸醫在狗的耳朵上發現了一隻壁蝨。

examples.en: The old clock on the wall ticks loudly all night.
examples.zh: 牆上的老時鐘整晚都滴答作響。

examples.en: Tick the box if you agree with the rules.
examples.zh: 如果你同意這些規定，請在方框內打勾。

examples.en: The teacher ticked each correct answer on my test.
examples.zh: 老師在我考卷上每個正確的答案都打了勾。

examples.en: We chose white tiles for the bathroom floor.
examples.zh: 我們為浴室地板選了白色磁磚。

examples.en: One tile on the kitchen wall is cracked.
examples.zh: 廚房牆上有一片磁磚裂開了。

examples.en: The roof is covered with red tiles.
examples.zh: 屋頂鋪滿了紅色的瓦片。

examples.en: They plan to tile the kitchen floor this weekend.
examples.zh: 他們打算這個週末在廚房地板鋪磁磚。

examples.en: My uncle tiled the whole bathroom by himself.
examples.zh: 我叔叔自己一個人把整間浴室都鋪好了磁磚。

examples.en: It took two days to tile the small entrance.
examples.zh: 鋪好這個小玄關的磁磚花了兩天。

examples.en: Drivers must pay a toll to use this bridge.
examples.zh: 駕駛人必須支付通行費才能使用這座橋。

examples.en: Working late every night has taken a toll on his health.
examples.zh: 每天加班到很晚，對他的健康造成了損害。

examples.en: The storm's death toll rose to ten by Sunday.
examples.zh: 到星期日為止，這場暴風雨的死亡人數增加到十人。

examples.en: The church bell tolls every hour.
examples.zh: 教堂的鐘每小時都會敲響。

examples.en: The school bell tolled to mark the end of class.
examples.zh: 學校的鐘聲響起，表示下課了。

examples.en: Old bells toll slowly across the quiet town.
examples.zh: 古老的鐘聲緩緩穿過寧靜的小鎮。

examples.en: The noise from the construction site tormented the neighbors.
examples.zh: 工地的噪音折磨著鄰居們。

examples.en: Guilt tormented her after she broke her friend's trust.
examples.zh: 她辜負朋友的信任後，內疚感一直折磨著她。

examples.en: Stop tormenting your little brother with silly jokes.
examples.zh: 別再用無聊的玩笑煩你弟弟了。

examples.en: Waiting for the test results was pure torment.
examples.zh: 等待考試結果簡直是一種折磨。

examples.en: He lived in torment after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故之後，他一直活在痛苦中。

examples.en: The long meeting was a torment for everyone.
examples.zh: 這場冗長的會議對每個人來說都是折磨。

examples.en: Our school team won the basketball tournament last month.
examples.zh: 我們學校的隊伍上個月贏得了籃球錦標賽。

examples.en: The tennis tournament will begin next Saturday.
examples.zh: 網球錦標賽將在下週六開始。

examples.en: She traveled to Japan for a chess tournament.
examples.zh: 她前往日本參加西洋棋比賽。

examples.en: Some cleaning products are toxic if you swallow them.
examples.zh: 有些清潔用品如果吞下去是有毒的。

examples.en: The factory was fined for releasing toxic waste into the river.
examples.zh: 這家工廠因把有毒廢棄物排入河中而被罰款。

examples.en: A toxic work environment can harm your mental health.
examples.zh: 有害的職場環境可能傷害你的心理健康。

examples.en: Honesty is the most important trait in a good friend.
examples.zh: 誠實是好朋友最重要的特質。

examples.en: She has inherited her mother's curly hair and other family traits.
examples.zh: 她遺傳了媽媽的捲髮和其他家族特徵。

examples.en: Patience is a useful trait for a teacher.
examples.zh: 耐心對老師來說是很有用的特質。

examples.en: The team called him a traitor when he joined their rival.
examples.zh: 他加入對手隊伍時，隊友稱他為叛徒。

examples.en: In the story, the traitor shared the secret with the enemy.
examples.zh: 故事中，叛徒把秘密告訴了敵人。

examples.en: Nobody wanted to be friends with the traitor after that.
examples.zh: 那之後沒有人想跟那個叛徒當朋友。

examples.en: The bank will record every transaction on your account.
examples.zh: 銀行會記錄你帳戶的每一筆交易。

examples.en: The online transaction was completed in less than a minute.
examples.zh: 這筆線上交易不到一分鐘就完成了。

examples.en: Please keep the receipt as proof of the transaction.
examples.zh: 請保留收據作為交易的證明。

examples.en: The old factory went through a complete transformation into a museum.
examples.zh: 那間舊工廠徹底轉型成了博物館。

examples.en: Her transformation from a shy girl to a confident speaker surprised everyone.
