examples.zh: 她從害羞的女孩變成自信的演說者，讓大家都很驚訝。

examples.en: Digital technology has caused a major transformation in education.
examples.zh: 數位科技為教育帶來了重大的轉變。

examples.en: Many people use public transit to get to work.
examples.zh: 許多人搭乘大眾運輸工具上班。

examples.en: The package was damaged in transit.
examples.zh: 這個包裹在運送途中受損了。

examples.en: We were in transit in Tokyo before flying home.
examples.zh: 我們飛回家前，曾在東京過境轉機。

examples.en: Moving to a new school can be a difficult transition for children.
examples.zh: 轉到新學校對孩子來說可能是個困難的轉變。

examples.en: The company is making a smooth transition to online sales.
examples.zh: 這家公司正順利地轉型為線上銷售。

examples.en: The transition from summer to autumn is my favorite time of year.
examples.zh: 從夏天轉入秋天的過渡期是我最喜歡的時節。

examples.en: She transitioned from teaching to office work last year.
examples.zh: 她去年從教學工作轉為辦公室工作。

examples.en: The class will transition to online lessons next week.
examples.zh: 這個班級下週將轉為線上授課。

examples.en: Our team is transitioning to a new software system.
examples.zh: 我們的團隊正在轉換到新的軟體系統。

examples.en: The storm interrupted the television transmission last night.
examples.zh: 暴風雨讓昨晚的電視訊號傳送中斷了。

examples.en: Washing hands helps stop the transmission of germs.
examples.zh: 洗手有助於阻止細菌傳播。

examples.en: The mechanic said the car needs a new transmission.
examples.zh: 技師說這輛車需要換新的變速箱。

senses.zh: 透明的；公開透明的；容易識破的

examples.en: The box is made of transparent plastic, so you can see inside.
examples.zh: 這個盒子是用透明塑膠做的，所以看得到裡面。

examples.en: The school wants to be transparent about how it spends money.
examples.zh: 學校希望在經費使用上做到公開透明。

examples.en: Her excuse was so transparent that nobody believed her.
examples.zh: 她的藉口太明顯了，沒有人相信她。

examples.en: The emergency doctor treated a patient with severe chest trauma.
examples.zh: 急診醫師治療了一名胸部嚴重外傷的病人。

examples.en: Counselors work with students who have emotional trauma.
examples.zh: 輔導老師會協助有情緒創傷的學生。

examples.en: The trauma of losing his home stayed with him for years.
examples.zh: 失去家園的創傷在他心裡留了好幾年。

examples.en: The concert was a tribute to the singer's long career.
examples.zh: 這場演唱會是向這位歌手的漫長生涯致敬。

examples.en: Students wrote letters as a tribute to their retiring teacher.
examples.zh: 學生們寫信向即將退休的老師表達敬意。

examples.en: The small kingdom sent gold as tribute to the emperor.
examples.zh: 這個小王國向皇帝進貢黃金。

examples.en: Dust can trigger allergies in some people.
examples.zh: 灰塵可能會引發某些人的過敏。

examples.en: A small mistake triggered a long argument between the two friends.
examples.zh: 一個小失誤引發了兩位朋友之間的一場長時間爭吵。

examples.en: Any movement near the door will trigger the alarm.
examples.zh: 任何靠近門的動作都會觸發警報。

examples.en: Stress is a common trigger for headaches.
examples.zh: 壓力是頭痛的常見誘因。

examples.en: Loud noise is a trigger for the baby's crying.
examples.zh: 大聲響是這個嬰兒哭鬧的誘因。

examples.en: The museum guide pointed to the trigger on the antique rifle.
examples.zh: 博物館導覽員指著古董步槍上的扳機。

examples.en: My father trims the hedge in the garden every month.
examples.zh: 我爸爸每個月都會修剪花園裡的樹籬。

examples.en: I need to trim my bangs before the interview.
examples.zh: 面試前我得修剪一下瀏海。

examples.en: The company plans to trim its costs by ten percent.
examples.zh: 公司計畫把成本削減百分之十。

examples.en: She kept her garden neat and trim all year.
examples.zh: 她整年都把花園維持得整齊俐落。

examples.en: He stays trim by jogging every morning.
examples.zh: 他每天早上慢跑，所以保持著勻稱的身材。

examples.en: The soldier wore a trim uniform to the ceremony.
examples.zh: 那位軍人穿著合身整齊的制服參加典禮。

examples.en: The store offers triple points on every purchase this week.
examples.zh: 這家店本週所有購物都提供三倍點數。

examples.en: The athlete won a triple jump gold medal.
examples.zh: 那位選手贏得了三級跳遠的金牌。

examples.en: She ordered a triple scoop of ice cream.
examples.zh: 她點了三球的冰淇淋。

examples.en: The price of the ticket has tripled since last year.
examples.zh: 這張票的價格比去年漲了兩倍。

examples.en: The company hopes to triple its sales in five years.
examples.zh: 公司希望五年內讓銷售額成長為三倍。

examples.en: Rent in the city has nearly tripled in ten years.
examples.zh: 這個城市的房租在十年內幾乎漲成了三倍。

examples.en: Don't waste time arguing about trivial matters.
examples.zh: 別浪費時間爭論瑣碎的小事。

examples.en: The difference in price is trivial, so buy the better one.
examples.zh: 價格差異微不足道，所以買比較好的那個吧。

examples.en: He apologized for the trivial mistake in the report.
examples.zh: 他為報告中那個小錯誤道了歉。

examples.en: Our class proudly held the trophy after the sports day.
examples.zh: 運動會結束後，我們班驕傲地捧著獎盃。

examples.en: The trophy is on display in the school hall.
examples.zh: 獎盃陳列在學校的穿堂。

examples.en: She placed her first trophy on the shelf next to her books.
examples.zh: 她把第一座獎盃擺在書旁邊的架子上。

examples.en: The university raised its tuition again this year.
examples.zh: 這所大學今年又調漲了學費。

examples.en: She works part-time to pay her tuition.
examples.zh: 她打工來支付學費。

examples.en: Private tuition in math helped him pass the exam.
examples.zh: 數學的私人補習幫助他通過了考試。

examples.en: The doctor found a small tumor in his stomach.
examples.zh: 醫生在他的胃裡發現了一顆小腫瘤。

examples.en: The tests showed that the tumor was benign and growing slowly.
examples.zh: 檢查顯示這顆腫瘤是良性的，而且生長緩慢。

examples.en: She had surgery to remove the tumor last spring.
examples.zh: 她去年春天動了手術切除腫瘤。

examples.en: I made a tuna sandwich for lunch.
examples.zh: 我午餐做了一份鮪魚三明治。

examples.en: Fresh tuna is popular in many Japanese restaurants.
examples.zh: 新鮮的鮪魚在許多日本餐廳很受歡迎。

examples.en: The fishermen caught a huge tuna near the coast.
examples.zh: 漁夫在海岸附近捕到了一條巨大的鮪魚。

examples.en: Winning the championship is their ultimate goal.
examples.zh: 贏得冠軍是他們的最終目標。

examples.en: This hotel offers the ultimate luxury experience.
examples.zh: 這間飯店提供極致奢華的體驗。

examples.en: The ultimate decision belongs to the manager.
examples.zh: 最後的決定權在經理手上。

examples.en: The reporter uncovered a serious problem at the factory.
examples.zh: 記者揭露了這間工廠的一個嚴重問題。

examples.en: Scientists uncovered an ancient village under the sand.
examples.zh: 科學家在沙地下發現了一座古老的村落。

examples.en: She uncovered the pot and stirred the soup.
examples.zh: 她掀開鍋蓋攪拌了湯。

examples.en: My grandfather will undergo surgery next week.
examples.zh: 我爺爺下週要接受手術。

examples.en: The old bridge underwent major repairs this year.
examples.zh: 這座老橋今年進行了大規模整修。

examples.en: All new employees must undergo training in their first month.
examples.zh: 所有新進員工在第一個月都必須接受訓練。

examples.en: She is an undergraduate majoring in biology.
examples.zh: 她是主修生物的大學生。

examples.en: Undergraduates can borrow up to ten books from the library.
examples.zh: 大學部學生最多可以向圖書館借十本書。

examples.en: My brother was an undergraduate at a university in Taipei.
examples.zh: 我哥哥以前是台北一所大學的大學生。

examples.en: He took an undergraduate course in economics.
examples.zh: 他修了一門大學部的經濟學課程。

examples.en: Undergraduate students must finish this class before graduation.
examples.zh: 大學部學生畢業前必須修完這門課。

examples.en: She received an undergraduate degree in English.
examples.zh: 她取得了英文學士學位。

examples.en: Constant criticism can undermine a child's confidence.
examples.zh: 不斷的批評可能會逐漸削弱孩子的自信。

examples.en: Rumors about the manager undermined the team's trust in her.
examples.zh: 關於經理的謠言削弱了團隊對她的信任。

examples.en: Staying up late will undermine your efforts to stay healthy.
examples.zh: 熬夜會破壞你維持健康的努力。

examples.en: Can you help me undo this knot in my shoelace?
examples.zh: 你可以幫我解開鞋帶上的這個結嗎？

examples.en: Press this button to undo your last change.
examples.zh: 按下這個按鈕就能撤銷你的上一個更動。

examples.en: Nothing can undo the harm that the rumor caused.
examples.zh: 沒有任何事能挽回那個謠言造成的傷害。

examples.en: The government is trying to lower unemployment among young people.
examples.zh: 政府正努力降低年輕人的失業率。

examples.en: Unemployment rose sharply after the factory closed.
examples.zh: 工廠關閉後，失業人數大幅上升。

examples.en: He received money from the government during his unemployment.
examples.zh: 他在失業期間領取了政府的補助。

examples.en: She unfolded the map and looked for the train station.
examples.zh: 她攤開地圖，尋找火車站。

examples.en: The story unfolds slowly over the first chapter.
examples.zh: 故事在第一章中慢慢展開。

examples.en: We watched the events unfold on the news.
examples.zh: 我們從新聞上看著事情一步步發展。

examples.en: He used a key to unlock the front door.
examples.zh: 他用鑰匙打開了前門。

examples.en: You can unlock your phone with your fingerprint.
examples.zh: 你可以用指紋解鎖手機。

examples.en: Learning English can unlock many new opportunities.
examples.zh: 學英文可以開啟許多新的機會。

examples.en: The city experienced an unprecedented amount of rain this summer.
examples.zh: 這座城市今年夏天經歷了前所未有的雨量。

examples.en: The new phone has sold at an unprecedented speed.
examples.zh: 這款新手機以空前的速度熱賣。

examples.en: The pandemic caused unprecedented changes in how we work.
examples.zh: 疫情為我們的工作方式帶來了史無前例的改變。

examples.en: Please update the software on your phone.
examples.zh: 請更新你手機上的軟體。

examples.en: I'll update you after the meeting ends.
examples.zh: 會議結束後我會向你報告最新情況。

examples.en: The teacher updates the class website every Friday.
examples.zh: 老師每個星期五都會更新班級網站。

examples.en: The app received a major update last week.
examples.zh: 這個應用程式上週有了一次大更新。

examples.en: Here is a quick update on our project.
examples.zh: 以下是我們專案的最新進度。

examples.en: She sent me an update about the flight delay.
examples.zh: 她傳來關於班機延誤的最新消息。

examples.en: You can upgrade your phone to the latest software for free.
examples.zh: 你可以免費把手機升級到最新的軟體。

examples.en: The hotel upgraded us to a larger room at no extra cost.
examples.zh: 飯店免費幫我們升級到比較大的房間。

examples.en: The school plans to upgrade its computer lab next year.
examples.zh: 學校計畫明年升級電腦教室的設備。

examples.en: The software upgrade takes about ten minutes to install.
examples.zh: 這次軟體升級大約要花十分鐘安裝。

examples.en: She asked the airline for a free upgrade to business class.
examples.zh: 她向航空公司要求免費升等到商務艙。

examples.en: The new model is a big upgrade from the old one.
examples.zh: 這個新型號比舊款進步很多。

examples.en: The utility company will cut off the water for two hours tomorrow.
examples.zh: 自來水公司明天會停水兩個小時。

examples.en: This tool has great utility in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 這項工具在廚房裡非常實用。

examples.en: Our monthly utility bill includes water, gas and electricity.
examples.zh: 我們每月的水電瓦斯費用都列在同一張帳單上。

examples.en: Teachers should utilize every kind of tool to help students learn.
examples.zh: 老師應該運用各種工具來幫助學生學習。

examples.en: We utilize solar panels to produce electricity for the school.
examples.zh: 我們利用太陽能板為學校發電。

examples.en: The company utilizes social media to reach young customers.
examples.zh: 這家公司利用社群媒體來接觸年輕顧客。

examples.en: Sound cannot travel through a vacuum because it needs a medium.
examples.zh: 聲音需要介質，因此無法在真空中傳播。

examples.en: My brother used the vacuum to clean the living room.
examples.zh: 我哥哥用吸塵器打掃客廳。

examples.en: His sudden departure left a vacuum in the team.
examples.zh: 他突然離開，讓團隊出現了空缺。

examples.en: I vacuum the bedroom floor every weekend.
examples.zh: 我每個週末都用吸塵器打掃臥室地板。

examples.en: Please vacuum the stairs before the guests arrive.
examples.zh: 請在客人抵達前用吸塵器清掃樓梯。

examples.en: She vacuumed the sofa to remove the pet hair.
examples.zh: 她用吸塵器清理沙發上的寵物毛。

examples.en: The weather in spring is highly variable.
examples.zh: 春天的天氣非常多變。

examples.en: The store offers variable prices depending on the season.
examples.zh: 這家店的價格會隨季節而變動。

examples.en: She has a variable work schedule that changes every week.
examples.zh: 她的工作時間表每週都不一樣。

examples.en: Temperature is an important variable in this experiment.
examples.zh: 溫度是這個實驗中的重要變數。

examples.en: In math class, we learned how to find the value of a variable.
examples.zh: 我們在數學課學到如何求出變數的值。

examples.en: Cost is only one variable we need to consider.
examples.zh: 成本只是我們需要考慮的其中一個因素。

examples.en: There is a lot of variation in prices between these shops.
examples.zh: 這幾家店的價格差異很大。

examples.en: This song is a variation of a famous folk tune.
examples.zh: 這首歌是一首著名民謠的變奏曲。

examples.en: Small variations in color are normal for handmade products.
examples.zh: 手工製品在顏色上有些微差異是正常的。

examples.en: The nurse found a vein in my arm easily.
examples.zh: 護士很輕易就在我的手臂上找到了靜脈。

examples.en: You can see the veins on the back of this leaf.
examples.zh: 你可以看到這片葉子背面的葉脈。

examples.en: Miners discovered a vein of silver deep in the mountain.
examples.zh: 礦工在山的深處發現了一條銀礦脈。

examples.en: The school chose a large hall as the venue for the concert.
examples.zh: 學校選了一間大禮堂作為演唱會的場地。

examples.en: The wedding venue is only ten minutes from the station.
examples.zh: 婚禮場地離車站只要十分鐘。

examples.en: Please check the venue and time before you leave home.
examples.zh: 出門前請先確認地點和時間。

examples.en: We made a verbal agreement with the landlord.
examples.zh: 我們和房東達成了口頭協議。

examples.en: The test measures both verbal and math skills.
examples.zh: 這項測驗同時評量語文能力和數學能力。

examples.en: The teacher gave the students a verbal warning about being late.
examples.zh: 老師口頭警告學生不要遲到。

examples.en: The jury reached a verdict after two days of discussion.
examples.zh: 陪審團討論了兩天後做出裁決。

examples.en: The judge will announce the verdict tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 法官明天早上會宣布判決。

examples.en: Critics gave a positive verdict on the new film.
examples.zh: 影評人對這部新電影給予正面評價。

examples.en: Tonight's volleyball game is Taiwan versus Japan at the city stadium.
examples.zh: 今晚的排球賽是台灣對日本，在市立體育場舉行。

examples.en: The debate topic is city life versus country life.
examples.zh: 辯論的主題是都市生活對鄉村生活。

examples.en: It is a question of quality versus price.
examples.zh: 這是一個品質與價格之間的取捨問題。

examples.en: My uncle is a veteran of the airline industry.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是航空業的資深人士。

examples.en: The town holds a parade to honor veterans every year.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮每年都舉辦遊行來向退伍軍人致敬。

examples.en: The team has several veterans and a few new players.
examples.zh: 這支球隊有幾位老將和幾位新球員。

examples.en: She is a veteran teacher with thirty years of experience.
examples.zh: 她是一位有三十年經驗的資深教師。

examples.en: The veteran driver knew every road in the city.
examples.zh: 這位經驗豐富的司機熟知城裡的每條路。

examples.en: A veteran reporter led the interview with the mayor.
examples.zh: 一位資深記者主導了這場市長專訪。

examples.en: We flew to London via Hong Kong.
examples.zh: 我們經由香港飛往倫敦。

examples.en: You can send me the files via email.
examples.zh: 你可以透過電子郵件把檔案寄給我。

examples.en: The class meets via video call during the typhoon.
examples.zh: 颱風期間，這堂課透過視訊連線上課。

examples.en: This is the only viable plan we have right now.
examples.zh: 這是我們目前唯一可行的計畫。

examples.en: The small shop was not a viable business.
examples.zh: 這家小店不是個可行的生意。

examples.en: Scientists found that the seeds were still viable after ten years.
examples.zh: 科學家發現這些種子在十年後仍然能發芽。

examples.en: The vicious rumor hurt her feelings deeply.
examples.zh: 那個惡毒的謠言深深傷了她的心。

examples.en: A vicious storm shut down the airport last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚一場猛烈的暴風雨讓機場關閉了。

examples.en: Poor sleep and stress can create a vicious cycle.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足和壓力可能形成惡性循環。

examples.en: Millions of viewers watched the final game on TV.
examples.zh: 數百萬名觀眾在電視上收看了決賽。

examples.en: The video has more than a thousand viewers online right now.
examples.zh: 這支影片目前有一千多名線上觀看者。

examples.en: You need a PDF viewer to open this file.
examples.zh: 你需要 PDF 檢視程式才能開啟這個檔案。

examples.en: Everyone in the class has a different viewpoint on this issue.
examples.zh: 班上每個人對這個議題都有不同的看法。

examples.en: From my viewpoint, the plan is too expensive.
examples.zh: 依我的看法，這個計畫太貴了。

examples.en: The hill is a popular viewpoint for watching the sunrise.
examples.zh: 這座山丘是欣賞日出的熱門觀景點。

senses.zh: 虛擬的；線上的；實質上的

examples.en: The museum offers a virtual tour of its collection.
examples.zh: 這間博物館提供館藏的虛擬導覽。

examples.en: Students attended the virtual class from their homes.
examples.zh: 學生在家裡參加線上課程。

examples.en: The rule has become a virtual law in our office.
examples.zh: 這條規定在我們辦公室幾乎成了法律。

examples.en: You need a visa to travel to some countries.
examples.zh: 前往某些國家需要簽證。

examples.en: She applied for a student visa at the embassy.
examples.zh: 她在大使館申請了學生簽證。

examples.en: My tourist visa will expire at the end of the month.
examples.zh: 我的觀光簽證月底就會到期。

senses.zh: 嗓音的；直言不諱的；聲樂的

examples.en: The singer rested her vocal cords before the show.
examples.zh: 這位歌手在演出前讓她的聲帶休息。

examples.en: He is very vocal about his love for jazz.
examples.zh: 他毫不掩飾地表達自己對爵士樂的喜愛。

examples.en: Our school choir needs more vocal practice.
examples.zh: 我們學校的合唱團需要更多聲樂練習。

examples.en: The band's lead vocal sounds clear and warm.
examples.zh: 這個樂團的主唱聲音清晰又溫暖。

examples.en: The song has beautiful vocals and a simple piano part.
examples.zh: 這首歌有優美的歌聲和簡單的鋼琴伴奏。

examples.en: She recorded the vocals in a small studio.
examples.zh: 她在一間小錄音室裡錄製了人聲部分。

examples.en: The baby vomited after drinking too much milk.
examples.zh: 寶寶喝太多牛奶後吐了。

examples.en: I felt sick and wanted to vomit on the bus.
examples.zh: 我在公車上覺得噁心，想吐。

examples.en: Some people vomit when they are seasick.
examples.zh: 有些人暈船時會嘔吐。

examples.en: The nurse cleaned up the vomit on the floor.
examples.zh: 護士清理了地板上的嘔吐物。

examples.en: There was vomit on the back seat of the car.
examples.zh: 車子後座有嘔吐物。

examples.en: The smell of vomit made everyone leave the room.
examples.zh: 嘔吐物的氣味讓大家都離開了房間。

examples.en: I got a free gift voucher from the department store.
examples.zh: 我從百貨公司拿到一張免費禮券。

examples.en: Show this voucher at the counter to get a discount.
examples.zh: 在櫃檯出示這張折價券就能享有折扣。

examples.en: The hotel gave us a meal voucher for breakfast.
examples.zh: 飯店給了我們一張早餐餐券。

examples.en: They exchanged vows at a small ceremony by the sea.
examples.zh: 他們在海邊的小型儀式中交換誓詞。

examples.en: He kept his vow to visit his grandmother every week.
examples.zh: 他遵守誓言，每週都去探望奶奶。

examples.en: She made a vow to study harder this year.
examples.zh: 她立誓今年要更用功讀書。

examples.en: He vowed to never be late again.
examples.zh: 他發誓再也不遲到。

examples.en: The mayor vowed to fix the old bridge.
examples.zh: 市長誓言要修好那座老橋。

examples.en: We vowed to stay friends forever after graduating from high school.
examples.zh: 我們發誓高中畢業後要永遠當朋友。

senses.zh: 脆弱的；易受傷害的；易受攻擊的

examples.en: Young children are more vulnerable to colds in winter.
examples.zh: 幼童在冬天比較容易感冒。

examples.en: The old website was vulnerable to hackers.
examples.zh: 那個舊網站很容易遭到駭客入侵。

examples.en: She felt vulnerable when she spoke about her fears.
examples.zh: 她談到自己的恐懼時覺得自己很脆弱。

examples.en: The company keeps its products in a large warehouse.
examples.zh: 這家公司把產品存放在一間大型倉庫裡。

examples.en: Our order will leave the warehouse tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 我們的訂單明天早上會從倉庫出貨。

examples.en: He works at a warehouse near the harbor.
examples.zh: 他在港口附近的一間倉庫工作。

examples.en: The store warehouses its winter coats until October.
examples.zh: 這家店把冬季外套存放在倉庫裡，直到十月。

examples.en: They warehoused the goods before shipping them overseas.
examples.zh: 他們在把貨物運往海外前，先存放在倉庫。

examples.en: The factory warehouses extra parts for repairs.
examples.zh: 工廠把多餘的零件存放在倉庫以備維修。

examples.en: The warrior carried a shield and a long spear.
examples.zh: 那位戰士帶著盾牌和一支長矛。

examples.en: The museum has a statue of an ancient warrior.
examples.zh: 博物館裡有一座古代戰士的雕像。

examples.en: She is a true warrior who never gives up.
examples.zh: 她是一位永不放棄的真正勇士。

examples.en: Be wary of emails that ask for your password.
examples.zh: 對於要求提供密碼的電子郵件要提高警覺。

examples.en: The dog was wary of the new visitor.
examples.zh: 那隻狗對新來的訪客很戒備。

examples.en: She is wary about spending money on things she does not need.
examples.zh: 她對於把錢花在不需要的東西上很謹慎。

examples.en: I heard a weird noise coming from the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我聽到廚房傳來奇怪的聲音。

examples.en: It feels weird to be back at my old school.
examples.zh: 回到我的母校感覺怪怪的。

examples.en: He has a weird habit of eating pizza with a spoon.
examples.zh: 他有個怪習慣，會用湯匙吃披薩。

examples.en: I have no interest in that game whatsoever.
examples.zh: 我對那個遊戲完全沒有興趣。

examples.en: There is no evidence whatsoever that he was there.
examples.zh: 完全沒有證據顯示他當時在場。

examples.en: The medicine had no effect whatsoever on her cough.
examples.zh: 這種藥對她的咳嗽完全沒有效果。

examples.en: The elevator has enough space for a wheelchair.
examples.zh: 這部電梯有足夠的空間容納輪椅。

examples.en: My grandfather uses a wheelchair to get around the park.
examples.zh: 我爺爺用輪椅在公園裡移動。

examples.en: The bus has a ramp for passengers in a wheelchair.
examples.zh: 這輛公車有供乘坐輪椅的乘客使用的斜坡。

examples.en: Nobody knew the whereabouts of the missing keys.
examples.zh: 沒有人知道遺失鑰匙的下落。

examples.en: The police asked about his whereabouts last night.
examples.zh: 警方詢問他昨晚的行蹤。

examples.en: Please tell me your whereabouts if you are going to be late.
examples.zh: 如果你會遲到，請告訴我你人在哪裡。

examples.en: My sister loves spicy food, whereas I prefer mild dishes.
examples.zh: 我姊姊愛吃辣，而我偏好清淡的菜。

examples.en: Some students study at night, whereas others study in the morning.
examples.zh: 有些學生在晚上讀書，有些則在早上讀書。

examples.en: Summers here are hot, whereas winters are cool and dry.
examples.zh: 這裡夏天炎熱，冬天卻涼爽乾燥。

examples.en: The little boy began to whine when his mother said no.
examples.zh: 小男孩的媽媽說不行時，他開始哼哼唧唧地鬧脾氣。

examples.en: The puppy whined at the door to go outside.
examples.zh: 小狗在門口嗚嗚叫著想出去。

examples.en: Stop whining about the homework and start working on it.
examples.zh: 別再抱怨作業了，開始動手寫吧。

examples.en: We heard the whine of a jet engine overhead.
examples.zh: 我們聽到頭頂上傳來噴射引擎的刺耳聲。

examples.en: The dog let out a soft whine at the vet's office.
examples.zh: 那隻狗在動物醫院裡發出輕輕的嗚咽聲。

examples.en: His constant whine about the food annoyed everyone.
examples.zh: 他不停地抱怨食物，讓大家都很煩。

examples.en: She wore a long blond wig to the costume party.
examples.zh: 她戴了一頂金色長假髮去參加變裝派對。

examples.en: The actor put on a wig before the play began.
examples.zh: 演員在戲開演前戴上了假髮。

examples.en: The wig looks so natural that nobody noticed it.
examples.zh: 這頂假髮看起來很自然，沒有人發現。

examples.en: The driver cleaned the windshield before the long trip.
examples.zh: 司機在長途旅行前擦了擋風玻璃。

examples.en: A small stone hit the windshield and left a crack.
examples.zh: 一顆小石頭擊中擋風玻璃，留下一道裂痕。

examples.en: Turn on the wipers because rain is covering the windshield.
examples.zh: 雨水蓋住了擋風玻璃，把雨刷打開吧。

examples.en: The flowers withered because nobody watered them.
examples.zh: 因為沒有人澆水，這些花都枯萎了。

examples.en: Leaves wither and fall when autumn comes.
examples.zh: 秋天來臨時，樹葉會枯萎掉落。

examples.en: His hopes of winning slowly withered away.
examples.zh: 他獲勝的希望漸漸消失了。

examples.en: The host is famous for his witty jokes.
examples.zh: 這位主持人以機智風趣的笑話聞名。

examples.en: She wrote a witty reply to the customer's email.
examples.zh: 她回覆顧客的電子郵件時寫得很機智幽默。

examples.en: My grandfather is a witty man who always makes us laugh.
examples.zh: 我爺爺是個風趣的人，總是逗得我們哈哈大笑。

examples.en: Many people worship at the temple on the first day of the new year.
examples.zh: 許多人在新年第一天到廟裡參拜。

examples.en: Fans worship the singer and buy every album she makes.
examples.zh: 粉絲崇拜這位歌手，每張專輯都買。

examples.en: Ancient people worshipped the sun as a god.
examples.zh: 古代人把太陽當作神明來敬拜。

examples.en: The church holds a worship service every Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 這間教會每週日早上都有禮拜。

examples.en: The temple is a place of worship for thousands of families.
examples.zh: 這座廟是數千個家庭的祭拜場所。

examples.en: Their worship of the sun god lasted for centuries.
examples.zh: 他們對太陽神的崇拜持續了數百年。

examples.en: The family spent the weekend on a yacht near the island.
examples.zh: 這家人週末在島嶼附近的遊艇上度過。

examples.en: A large yacht was waiting at the harbor.
examples.zh: 一艘大型遊艇正停在港口等候。

examples.en: He dreams of sailing around the world on his own yacht.
examples.zh: 他夢想駕著自己的遊艇環遊世界。

examples.en: The apple trees yield plenty of fruit every autumn.
examples.zh: 這些蘋果樹每年秋天都結出大量果實。

examples.en: Drivers must yield to people crossing the street.
examples.zh: 駕駛人必須禮讓過馬路的行人。

examples.en: The company finally yielded to the customers' demands.
examples.zh: 公司最後對顧客的要求讓步了。

examples.en: The farmer was pleased with this year's rice yield.
examples.zh: 農夫對今年的稻米產量很滿意。

examples.en: The bank offers a higher yield on long-term savings.
examples.zh: 這家銀行對長期存款提供較高的收益。

examples.en: Our science report explains how good weather increased the crop yield.
examples.zh: 我們的科學報告解釋了好天氣如何提高農作物的產量。

examples.en: The children played with the dog in the backyard.
examples.zh: 孩子們在後院和狗玩。

examples.en: We planted tomatoes in our backyard last spring.
examples.zh: 我們去年春天在後院種了番茄。

examples.en: They are going to have a barbecue in the backyard on Saturday.
examples.zh: 他們星期六要在後院烤肉。

examples.en: He applied for citizenship after living here for ten years.
examples.zh: 他在這裡住了十年後申請公民身分。

examples.en: The class teaches students about good citizenship.
examples.zh: 這堂課教導學生良好的公民素養。

examples.en: Her citizenship allows her to vote in the election.
examples.zh: 她的公民身分讓她能在選舉中投票。

examples.en: Reading regularly helps children build cognitive skills from an early age.
examples.zh: 規律閱讀有助於孩子從小培養認知能力。

examples.en: The study looks at cognitive changes in older adults.
examples.zh: 這項研究探討年長者的認知變化。

examples.en: Cognitive development is fast in the first few years of life.
examples.zh: 孩子在生命最初幾年的認知發展非常快速。

examples.en: All workers must act in compliance with the safety rules.
examples.zh: 所有員工都必須遵守安全規定。

examples.en: The company hired a manager to check legal compliance.
examples.zh: 公司聘請了一位經理來檢查法規遵循情形。

examples.en: Compliance with the school dress code is required.
examples.zh: 必須遵守學校的服儀規定。

examples.en: The professor gave a long discourse on modern art.
examples.zh: 教授針對現代藝術發表了一段長篇論述。

examples.en: Public discourse about climate change has grown in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年來公眾對氣候變遷的討論越來越多。

examples.en: Good discourse needs respect and careful listening.
examples.zh: 良好的論述需要尊重與用心傾聽。

examples.en: The teacher discoursed on the history of the town.
examples.zh: 老師詳細談論了這個小鎮的歷史。

examples.en: He likes to discourse about politics at dinner.
examples.zh: 他喜歡在晚餐時高談政治。

examples.en: They discoursed for hours about the future of education.
examples.zh: 他們花了好幾個小時談論教育的未來。

examples.en: I can envision a bright future for our school.
examples.zh: 我可以想像我們學校有個光明的未來。

examples.en: The architect envisioned a park in the center of the city.
examples.zh: 建築師設想在市中心建造一座公園。

examples.en: She envisions herself working as a doctor one day.
examples.zh: 她想像自己有一天成為醫生。

examples.en: My job offers a lot of flexibility in working hours.
examples.zh: 我的工作在上班時間上很有彈性。

examples.en: Yoga can improve your flexibility and balance.
examples.zh: 瑜伽可以增進你的柔軟度與平衡感。

examples.en: The plan needs more flexibility in case it rains.
examples.zh: 萬一下雨，這個計畫需要更有彈性。

examples.en: He flipped the pancake over with a spatula.
examples.zh: 他用鍋鏟把鬆餅翻面。

examples.en: Please flip to page ten in your textbook.
examples.zh: 請把課本翻到第十頁。

examples.en: We flipped a coin to decide who would go first.
examples.zh: 我們擲硬幣來決定誰先開始。

examples.en: The gymnast did a perfect flip in the air.
examples.zh: 這位體操選手在空中完成了完美的翻轉。

examples.en: With a quick flip of his wrist, he turned the card over.
examples.zh: 他手腕輕輕一翻，就把牌翻過來了。

examples.en: The result depended on the flip of a coin.
examples.zh: 結果取決於擲硬幣。

examples.en: The train carries freight from the port to the city.
examples.zh: 這列火車把貨物從港口運到市區。

examples.en: We paid extra for air freight to get the parcel faster.
examples.zh: 我們多付了空運運費，好讓包裹更快送達。

examples.en: The freight company delivers goods all over the island.
examples.zh: 這家貨運公司把貨物送到全島各地。

examples.en: Click the small icon on the top of the screen.
examples.zh: 請點選螢幕上方的小圖示。

examples.en: The singer became a pop icon in the 1990s.
examples.zh: 這位歌手在 1990 年代成為流行偶像。

examples.en: The tower is an icon of the city.
examples.zh: 這座塔是這座城市的象徵。

examples.en: My mentor at work taught me how to write professional emails.
examples.zh: 我在公司的導師教我怎麼寫專業的電子郵件。

examples.en: Every new student at the school gets a mentor in the upper grades.
examples.zh: 學校裡每位新生都會有一位高年級的學長姊當導師。

examples.en: She has been a mentor to many young teachers.
examples.zh: 她一直是許多年輕教師的良師。

examples.en: Senior engineers mentor the new employees during their first year.
examples.zh: 資深工程師在新進員工的第一年擔任他們的導師。

examples.en: He volunteers to mentor students who need help with math.
examples.zh: 他自願指導需要數學協助的學生。

examples.en: She mentored me through my first big project.
examples.zh: 她陪著我走過第一個大型專案，一路給我指導。

examples.en: The mortality rate for this disease has dropped sharply in recent years.
examples.zh: 這種疾病的死亡率近幾年大幅下降。

examples.en: Better hospitals have lowered infant mortality across the country.
examples.zh: 更好的醫院降低了全國的嬰兒死亡率。

examples.en: Visiting the old town reminded him of his own mortality.
examples.zh: 造訪老城區讓他想起自己終究難免一死。

examples.en: She works for a nonprofit organization that helps stray dogs.
examples.zh: 她在一個幫助流浪狗的非營利組織工作。

examples.en: Our school library is run by a nonprofit group.
examples.zh: 我們學校的圖書館由一個非營利團體經營。

examples.en: The nonprofit hospital offers free checkups to elderly people.
examples.zh: 這家非營利醫院提供老年人免費健康檢查。

examples.en: The nonprofit raised enough money to build a new playground.
examples.zh: 這個非營利組織募到足夠的錢蓋一座新的遊樂場。

examples.en: Many nonprofits depend on volunteers to run their programs.
examples.zh: 許多非營利組織仰賴志工來推動各項計畫。

examples.en: He left his job to start a nonprofit for young artists.
examples.zh: 他辭掉工作，為年輕藝術家創辦了一個非營利組織。

senses.zh: 擺放位置；分班；就業安置

examples.en: The placement of the sofa makes the living room feel bigger.
examples.zh: 沙發擺放的位置讓客廳感覺比較大。

examples.en: Students take a test for class placement at the start of the term.
examples.zh: 學生在學期初要參加分班測驗。

examples.en: The agency helps with job placement for recent graduates.
examples.zh: 這家機構協助應屆畢業生就業。

examples.en: Most respondents said they prefer taking the MRT to work.
examples.zh: 大多數受訪者表示他們比較喜歡搭捷運上班。

examples.en: Each respondent must answer ten questions about school lunches.
examples.zh: 每位受訪者都必須回答十個關於學校午餐的問題。

examples.en: The respondent in the case agreed to attend the hearing.
examples.zh: 這件案子的被告同意出席聽證會。

examples.en: The sensor turns on the light when someone walks in.
examples.zh: 有人走進來時，感應器就會把燈打開。

examples.en: This sensor measures the temperature of the water.
examples.zh: 這個感測器可以測量水的溫度。

examples.en: Our new phone has a sensor that detects your fingerprint.
examples.zh: 我們的新手機有一個可以辨識指紋的感應器。

examples.en: She tucked a loose strand of hair behind her ear.
examples.zh: 她把一縷散落的頭髮塞到耳後。

examples.en: The spider hung from a single strand of silk.
examples.zh: 那隻蜘蛛掛在一條蜘蛛絲上。

examples.en: Each strand of the rope is made of strong fibers.
examples.zh: 這條繩子的每一股都是用堅韌的纖維製成的。

examples.en: The heavy snow stranded many travelers at the airport.
examples.zh: 大雪使許多旅客受困在機場。

examples.en: Low tide stranded the boat on a sandbank near the shore.
examples.zh: 退潮使那艘船擱淺在近岸的沙洲上。

examples.en: We were stranded in the village after the bridge collapsed.
examples.zh: 橋斷了之後，我們被困在那個村莊。

examples.en: This restaurant is supposedly the best in town.
examples.zh: 據說這家餐廳是鎮上最好的。

examples.en: He was supposedly studying, but I heard loud music from his room.
examples.zh: 據說他在讀書，可是我聽見他房間傳出很大的音樂聲。

examples.en: The bridge is supposedly safe, but I still feel nervous.
examples.zh: 這座橋據稱很安全，但我還是覺得緊張。

examples.en: He studied theology at university before becoming a teacher.
examples.zh: 他在成為老師之前，先在大學修讀神學。

examples.en: The library has a large collection of books on theology.
examples.zh: 這間圖書館有大量的神學書籍。

examples.en: She gave a talk on the history of Christian theology.
examples.zh: 她做了一場關於基督教神學歷史的演講。

examples.en: She is undoubtedly the best singer in our class.
examples.zh: 她無疑是我們班上唱得最好的人。

examples.en: This is undoubtedly a good time to buy a new laptop.
examples.zh: 現在無疑是買新筆電的好時機。

examples.en: The team was undoubtedly tired after the long trip.
examples.zh: 經過長途旅行，這支隊伍無疑很累。

examples.en: She keeps her socks in the top drawer of the dresser.
examples.zh: 她把襪子放在五斗櫃最上面的抽屜裡。

examples.en: There is a mirror above the dresser in my bedroom.
examples.zh: 我臥室的梳妝台上方有一面鏡子。

examples.en: We bought a wooden dresser for the baby's room.
examples.zh: 我們為寶寶的房間買了一個木製五斗櫃。

examples.en: Please buy a liter of milk on your way home.
examples.zh: 你回家的路上請買一公升的牛奶。

examples.en: This bottle holds about half a liter of water.
examples.zh: 這個瓶子大約可以裝半公升的水。

examples.en: The car uses one liter of gas for every twelve kilometers.
examples.zh: 這輛車每跑十二公里要用一公升的汽油。

examples.en: The sneaky cat stole a piece of fish from the table.
examples.zh: 那隻狡猾的貓從桌上偷了一塊魚。

examples.en: He gave me a sneaky smile before he opened the gift.
examples.zh: 他在拆禮物之前對我露出一抹狡黠的微笑。

examples.en: It was sneaky of her to read my diary.
examples.zh: 她偷看我的日記，真是偷偷摸摸。

examples.en: I bought some new stationery before the school year started.
examples.zh: 開學前我買了一些新文具。

examples.en: The store sells pens, notebooks, and other stationery.
examples.zh: 這家店賣筆、筆記本和其他文具。

examples.en: She wrote the invitation on pretty pink stationery.
examples.zh: 她把邀請函寫在漂亮的粉紅色信紙上。

examples.en: Students walk through the underpass to get to the school gate.
examples.zh: 學生穿過地下道走到學校大門。

examples.en: The underpass floods whenever it rains heavily.
examples.zh: 每次下大雨，這條地下道都會淹水。

examples.en: A new underpass will help reduce traffic near the station.
examples.zh: 一條新的地下道將有助於減少車站附近的車流。

examples.en: I keep my gym clothes in my locker at school.
examples.zh: 我把體育服放在學校的置物櫃裡。

examples.en: Please put your bag in a locker before entering the museum.
examples.zh: 進入博物館之前，請把包包放進寄物櫃。

examples.en: He forgot the combination to his locker after summer vacation.
examples.zh: 暑假過後，他忘了置物櫃的密碼。

examples.en: I need a new pair of sneakers for gym class.
examples.zh: 我需要一雙新的運動鞋來上體育課。

examples.en: These white sneakers go well with jeans.
examples.zh: 這雙白色球鞋跟牛仔褲很搭。

examples.en: He tied the laces of his sneaker and started to run.
examples.zh: 他綁好球鞋的鞋帶，開始跑步。

examples.en: She studied music at a famous academy in Vienna.
examples.zh: 她在維也納一所著名的音樂學院學習音樂。

examples.en: The police academy trains new officers for two years.
examples.zh: 警察學院為新進警員提供為期兩年的訓練。

examples.en: The Academy of Sciences holds a public lecture every month.
examples.zh: 科學院每個月都會舉辦一場公開演講。

examples.en: The farm covers about fifty acres of land.
examples.zh: 這座農場占地約五十英畝。

examples.en: They bought an acre of land near the lake.
examples.zh: 他們在湖邊買了一英畝的土地。

examples.en: The park is ten acres in size, with a large pond in the middle.
examples.zh: 這座公園有十英畝大，中間有一座大池塘。

examples.en: The village is at an altitude of two thousand meters.
examples.zh: 這個村莊海拔兩千公尺。

examples.en: The plane climbed to a cruising altitude of ten thousand meters.
examples.zh: 飛機爬升到一萬公尺的巡航高度。

examples.en: Some hikers feel dizzy at high altitude.
examples.zh: 有些登山客在高海拔地區會覺得頭暈。

examples.en: The children played happily amid the colorful flowers.
examples.zh: 孩子們在五顏六色的花叢中開心地玩耍。

examples.en: She stayed calm amid all the noise and confusion.
examples.zh: 在一片吵雜與混亂之中，她依然保持冷靜。

examples.en: Prices keep rising amid worries about the economy.
examples.zh: 在對經濟的擔憂之中，物價持續上漲。

examples.en: The audience stood up to applaud the singer.
examples.zh: 觀眾起立為那位歌手鼓掌。

examples.en: Everyone applauded when the winner walked on stage.
examples.zh: 優勝者走上舞台時，大家都鼓掌歡迎。

examples.en: Teachers applaud students who work hard and help others.
examples.zh: 老師稱讚那些用功又樂於助人的學生。

examples.en: My little brother is learning basic arithmetic in first grade.
examples.zh: 我弟弟一年級就在學基本的算術。

examples.en: Mental arithmetic helps you check the bill quickly.
examples.zh: 心算可以幫你很快核對帳單。

examples.en: Addition and subtraction are the simplest forms of arithmetic.
examples.zh: 加法和減法是最簡單的算術。

examples.en: The balloon slowly began to ascend into the sky.
examples.zh: 氣球慢慢開始升向天空。

examples.en: We ascended the stairs to the top floor of the tower.
examples.zh: 我們沿著階梯登上塔的頂樓。

examples.en: The climbers ascend the mountain early in the morning.
examples.zh: 登山客在清晨攀登這座山。

examples.en: The museum has an exhibit about the plot to assassinate the king.
examples.zh: 博物館有一個關於暗殺國王陰謀的展覽。

examples.en: Historians still discuss why the leader was assassinated.
examples.zh: 歷史學家至今仍在討論這位領袖遭到暗殺的原因。

examples.en: The book tells how rebels tried to assassinate the president.
examples.zh: 這本書講述叛軍如何試圖暗殺總統。

examples.en: The astronaut waved to the crowd before boarding the rocket.
examples.zh: 太空人在登上火箭之前向群眾揮手。

examples.en: My cousin dreams of becoming an astronaut someday.
examples.zh: 我表哥夢想有一天成為太空人。

examples.en: The astronauts spent six months on the space station.
examples.zh: 太空人們在太空站待了六個月。

examples.en: The hotel gave us a booklet about local attractions.
examples.zh: 飯店給了我們一本介紹當地景點的小冊子。

examples.en: Please read the safety booklet before using the machine.
examples.zh: 使用機器之前，請先閱讀安全手冊。

examples.en: She designed a small booklet for the school festival.
examples.zh: 她為校慶設計了一本小冊子。

examples.en: Many customers decided to boycott the store after the scandal.
examples.zh: 醜聞爆發後，許多顧客決定抵制那家商店。

examples.en: Some fans threatened to boycott the concert over high ticket prices.
examples.zh: 有些粉絲因為票價太高而揚言杯葛這場演唱會。

examples.en: The group urged people to boycott products made with child labor.
examples.zh: 這個團體呼籲大眾抵制使用童工生產的產品。

examples.en: The boycott lasted for several months until the store improved working conditions.
examples.zh: 這次抵制行動持續了好幾個月，直到那家商店改善工作條件才結束。

examples.en: Students called for a boycott of the cafeteria.
examples.zh: 學生們呼籲杯葛學生餐廳。

examples.en: The company lost money because of the consumer boycott.
examples.zh: 這家公司因為消費者的抵制而虧損。

examples.en: The official was fired for taking a bribe.
examples.zh: 那名官員因為收賄而被解僱。

examples.en: He refused the bribe and reported it to the authorities.
examples.zh: 他拒絕了賄款，並向主管機關舉報。

examples.en: A bribe is against the law in almost every country.
examples.zh: 在幾乎每個國家，行賄都是違法的。

examples.en: It is illegal to bribe a police officer.
examples.zh: 賄賂警察是違法的。

examples.en: The businessman tried to bribe the inspector with a gift.
examples.zh: 那名商人試圖用禮物賄賂檢查員。

examples.en: My little sister tried to bribe me with candy.
examples.zh: 我妹妹想用糖果收買我。

examples.en: We sat by the brook and listened to the water.
examples.zh: 我們坐在小溪旁聽著流水聲。

examples.en: A small brook runs behind our grandparents' house.
examples.zh: 我們祖父母家後面有一條小溪流過。

examples.en: The children jumped across the brook to reach the other side.
examples.zh: 孩子們跳過小溪到對岸去。

examples.en: You may use a calculator during the math exam.
examples.zh: 數學考試時，你可以使用計算機。

examples.en: I forgot to bring my calculator to class.
examples.zh: 我忘了把計算機帶來上課。

examples.en: The calculator on my phone is easy to use.
examples.zh: 我手機上的計算機很好用。

examples.en: The little boy wore a red cape and pretended to be a hero.
examples.zh: 小男孩披著紅色披風，假裝自己是英雄。

examples.en: We took a boat ride around the cape.
examples.zh: 我們搭船繞行那個海角。

examples.en: A long black cape covered her shoulders in the cold wind.
examples.zh: 寒風中，一件黑色長斗篷罩住了她的肩膀。

examples.en: The caption under the photo explains where it was taken.
examples.zh: 照片下方的圖說解釋了拍攝地點。

examples.en: I wrote a funny caption for my vacation picture.
examples.zh: 我為我的度假照片寫了一段有趣的說明文字。

examples.en: Turn on the captions if you cannot hear the dialogue.
examples.zh: 如果聽不清楚對白，請開啟字幕。

examples.en: The editor will caption each photo in the magazine.
examples.zh: 編輯會替雜誌裡的每張照片加上說明文字。

examples.en: Students were asked to caption the pictures in English.
examples.zh: 學生被要求用英文為這些圖片加上說明。

examples.en: She captioned the video with a short message.
examples.zh: 她在影片上加了一段簡短的說明文字。

examples.en: The cashier gave me my change and a receipt.
examples.zh: 收銀員把零錢和收據遞給我。

examples.en: My sister works as a cashier at a supermarket.
examples.zh: 我姊姊在超市當收銀員。

examples.en: Please pay the cashier near the exit.
examples.zh: 請在出口附近向收銀員結帳。

examples.en: There were no casualties in the traffic accident.
examples.zh: 這場車禍沒有人傷亡。

examples.en: The storm caused many casualties in the coastal town.
examples.zh: 暴風雨在海邊小鎮造成許多傷亡。

examples.en: Small shops were the first casualty of the new mall.
examples.zh: 小商店成了這家新購物中心的第一批受害者。

examples.en: The caterpillar slowly crawled along the green leaf.
examples.zh: 那隻毛毛蟲沿著綠葉慢慢爬行。

examples.en: A caterpillar will eventually turn into a butterfly or a moth.
examples.zh: 毛毛蟲最終會變成蝴蝶或蛾。

examples.en: My daughter found a hairy caterpillar in the garden.
examples.zh: 我女兒在花園裡發現一隻長滿細毛的毛毛蟲。

examples.en: Workers mixed sand, gravel, water, and cement to make concrete.
examples.zh: 工人把沙、碎石、水和水泥混合來製作混凝土。

examples.en: The road was repaired with fresh cement.
examples.zh: 這條路用新的水泥修補好了。

examples.en: A bag of cement is heavy for one person to lift.
examples.zh: 一袋水泥對一個人來說很重，不好搬。

examples.en: They cemented the stones together to build a wall.
examples.zh: 他們把石頭用水泥黏合起來砌成一道牆。

examples.en: Working together on the school festival cemented our friendship.
examples.zh: 一起籌辦校慶鞏固了我們的友誼。

examples.en: The two countries signed a deal to cement their relationship.
examples.zh: 兩國簽署協議來鞏固彼此的關係。

examples.en: The chemist tested the water for harmful substances.
examples.zh: 化學家檢測水中是否含有有害物質。

examples.en: My aunt is a chemist who works for a pharmaceutical company.
examples.zh: 我阿姨是一位在製藥公司工作的化學家。

examples.en: Ask the chemist if this medicine is safe for children.
examples.zh: 請問藥師這種藥對小孩是否安全。

examples.en: My grandfather used to smoke a cigar after dinner.
examples.zh: 我祖父以前晚餐後會抽一根雪茄。

examples.en: The shop sells cigars from several different countries.
examples.zh: 這家店販售來自好幾個不同國家的雪茄。

examples.en: A box of cigars was the gift for his retirement party.
examples.zh: 一盒雪茄是他退休派對的禮物。

examples.en: Early explorers claimed they wanted to civilize the local people.
examples.zh: 早期的探險家聲稱他們想教化當地的居民。

examples.en: Good manners help civilize the way we treat one another.
examples.zh: 良好的禮儀有助於使我們彼此相待的方式更加文明。

examples.en: Education can civilize a society and reduce conflict.
examples.zh: 教育可以使社會更文明，也能減少衝突。

examples.en: The climax of the movie made everyone in the theater gasp.
examples.zh: 電影的高潮讓戲院裡的每個人都倒抽一口氣。

examples.en: The concert reached its climax with a fireworks show.
examples.zh: 演唱會在煙火秀中達到最高潮。

examples.en: The story builds slowly toward a surprising climax.
examples.zh: 故事慢慢鋪陳，朝著令人驚訝的高潮發展。

examples.en: The race climaxed with a dramatic photo finish.
examples.zh: 比賽在驚險的衝線中達到高潮，須靠終點攝影判定勝負。

examples.en: The festival climaxes on the last night with a parade.
examples.zh: 節慶在最後一晚以遊行達到高潮。

examples.en: Tension in the play climaxes in the final scene.
examples.zh: 這齣戲的緊張氣氛在最後一幕達到頂點。

senses.zh: 比較的；相對的；比較級的

examples.en: She is studying comparative literature at university.
examples.zh: 她在大學學習比較文學。

examples.en: We enjoyed the comparative quiet of the countryside.
examples.zh: 我們很享受鄉間相對的寧靜。

examples.en: The teacher explained the comparative form of the adjective.
examples.zh: 老師解釋了這個形容詞的比較級形式。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to write a comparative for each adjective.
examples.zh: 老師要我們為每個形容詞寫出一個比較級。

examples.en: Students must choose the correct comparative in this exercise.
examples.zh: 學生必須在這個練習中選出正確的比較級。

examples.en: Use a comparative when you compare two things.
examples.zh: 比較兩件事物時要用比較級。

examples.en: The program can compute the total cost in seconds.
examples.zh: 這個程式可以在幾秒內計算出總費用。

examples.en: Students learn how to compute the area of a circle.
examples.zh: 學生學習如何計算圓的面積。

examples.en: It is hard to compute how much time we will need.
examples.zh: 很難估算我們會需要多少時間。

examples.en: The letter B is a consonant, not a vowel.
examples.zh: 字母 B 是子音，不是母音。

examples.en: This word has three consonants in a row.
examples.zh: 這個字有連續三個子音。

examples.en: Students practice pronouncing each consonant clearly during their English lessons.
examples.zh: 學生在英文課上練習把每個子音念清楚。

examples.en: She tried to cram too many clothes into her small suitcase.
examples.zh: 她想把太多衣服塞進她的小行李箱。

examples.en: Many students cram the night before an exam.
examples.zh: 許多學生在考試前一晚臨時抱佛腳。

examples.en: Several passengers crammed into the elevator before the doors closed.
examples.zh: 幾位乘客在電梯門關上前擠進了電梯。

examples.en: He used a crutch to walk after the surgery.
examples.zh: 他手術後靠一支拐杖走路。

examples.en: The nurse helped her adjust the height of the crutches.
examples.zh: 護理師幫她調整拐杖的高度。

examples.en: Some people use social media as a crutch when they feel lonely.
examples.zh: 有些人覺得孤單時，會把社群媒體當成依靠。

examples.en: The lion cub stayed close to its mother.
examples.zh: 那隻幼獅緊靠在牠媽媽身邊。

examples.en: We saw a bear cub playing near the river.
examples.zh: 我們看到一隻小熊在河邊玩耍。

examples.en: The zoo announced the birth of two tiger cubs.
examples.zh: 動物園宣布兩隻幼虎誕生了。

examples.en: My mother put sliced cucumber in the salad.
examples.zh: 我媽媽在沙拉裡加了切片的小黃瓜。

examples.en: A cucumber is mostly made of water.
examples.zh: 小黃瓜的成分大部分是水。

examples.en: Do you want a cucumber sandwich for lunch?
examples.zh: 你午餐想吃小黃瓜三明治嗎？

examples.en: Farmers in this area cultivate rice and sweet potatoes.
examples.zh: 這個地區的農夫種植稻米和地瓜。

examples.en: It takes time to cultivate good study habits.
examples.zh: 培養良好的讀書習慣需要時間。

examples.en: She cultivated a friendship with her new neighbor.
examples.zh: 她與新鄰居建立起了友誼。

examples.en: Add a little detergent to the washing machine.
examples.zh: 在洗衣機裡加一點洗衣精。

examples.en: This dish detergent is gentle on your hands.
examples.zh: 這款洗碗精對雙手很溫和。

examples.en: We ran out of detergent, so I need to buy more.
examples.zh: 我們的洗衣精用完了，所以我得再買一些。

examples.en: The manager will dictate a letter to her assistant this afternoon.
examples.zh: 經理今天下午會對助理口述一封信。

examples.en: The school rules dictate that students must wear uniforms.
examples.zh: 學校規定學生必須穿制服。

examples.en: Parents should not dictate every choice their children make.
examples.zh: 父母不該決定孩子的每一個選擇。

examples.en: Many people simply follow the dictates of fashion.
examples.zh: 許多人只是遵循時尚的要求。

examples.en: She always listens to the dictates of her conscience.
examples.zh: 她總是聽從良心的指示。

examples.en: The company ignored the dictates of common sense.
examples.zh: 那家公司不依常理行事。

examples.en: Our English teacher gives us a dictation every Friday morning.
examples.zh: 我們的英文老師每週五早上都會讓我們聽寫。

examples.en: The secretary took dictation while the boss walked around the room.
examples.zh: 老闆在房間裡走動時，秘書記錄他的口述內容。

examples.en: I made three spelling mistakes in the dictation test.
examples.zh: 我在聽寫測驗中拼錯了三個字。

examples.en: Please discard the empty bottles in the recycling bin.
examples.zh: 請把空瓶丟進資源回收桶。

examples.en: He discarded his old notes after the final exam.
examples.zh: 期末考結束後，他把舊筆記丟掉了。

examples.en: The committee decided to discard the original plan.
examples.zh: 委員會決定放棄原本的計畫。

examples.en: The shop sells clothes made from fabric discards.
examples.zh: 那家店販售用廢棄布料製成的衣服。

examples.en: In the card game, each player puts a discard on the table.
examples.zh: 玩這個紙牌遊戲時，每位玩家都要在桌上放一張棄牌。

examples.en: The artist turned factory discards into beautiful sculptures.
examples.zh: 那位藝術家把工廠的廢棄物變成美麗的雕塑。

examples.en: The noise from the street was a constant disturbance during the exam.
examples.zh: 考試期間，街上的噪音一直造成干擾。

examples.en: Please do not cause any disturbance in the library.
examples.zh: 請不要在圖書館裡製造任何干擾。

examples.en: Neighbors called the police because of a disturbance late at night.
examples.zh: 鄰居因為深夜的騷動而報警。

examples.en: Freshmen usually live in the dormitory on campus.
examples.zh: 大一新生通常住在校內的宿舍。

examples.en: Each dormitory room has two beds and two desks.
examples.zh: 每間宿舍房間都有兩張床和兩張書桌。

examples.en: The dormitory closes its front door at eleven o'clock.
examples.zh: 宿舍在十一點關上大門。

examples.en: The road slopes downward toward the river.
examples.zh: 這條路朝河邊向下傾斜。

examples.en: She looked downward and saw her shoes were untied.
examples.zh: 她往下看，發現鞋帶鬆了。

examples.en: Prices of electronic products have moved downward this year.
examples.zh: 今年電子產品的價格有所下滑。

examples.en: The company reported a downward trend in sales.
examples.zh: 那家公司回報銷售量呈下降趨勢。

examples.en: He made a downward movement with his hand.
examples.zh: 他用手做了一個向下的動作。

examples.en: We took the downward path to the lake.
examples.zh: 我們沿著下坡的小徑走到湖邊。

examples.en: Grandpa likes to doze in his chair after lunch.
examples.zh: 爺爺午餐後喜歡坐在椅子上打盹。

examples.en: I dozed during the long speech and missed the ending.
examples.zh: 我在冗長的演講中打瞌睡，錯過了結尾。

examples.en: Passengers dozed quietly on the night train.
examples.zh: 夜車上的乘客安靜地打著瞌睡。

examples.en: He took a short doze on the sofa before dinner.
examples.zh: 他在晚餐前在沙發上小睡了一下。

examples.en: A quick doze helped me feel fresh again.
examples.zh: 小睡片刻讓我又恢復了精神。

examples.en: She had a doze on the bus ride home.
examples.zh: 她在回家的公車上打了個盹。

examples.en: The duration of the movie is about two hours.
examples.zh: 這部電影的片長大約兩小時。

examples.en: Please keep your phone off for the duration of the exam.
examples.zh: 考試期間請將手機關機。

examples.en: The course is short in duration but very useful.
examples.zh: 這門課時間不長，但非常實用。

examples.en: We walked along the beach at dusk.
examples.zh: 我們在黃昏時沿著海灘散步。

examples.en: The street lights come on at dusk.
examples.zh: 路燈在傍晚時亮起。

examples.en: Bats start flying around the park at dusk.
examples.zh: 蝙蝠在黃昏時開始在公園裡飛來飛去。

examples.en: These mushrooms are edible, but those red ones are not.
examples.zh: 這些蘑菇可以吃，但那些紅色的不行。

examples.en: The cake was so hard that it was barely edible.
examples.zh: 那個蛋糕硬到幾乎無法食用。

examples.en: The decorations on the table are all edible.
examples.zh: 桌上的裝飾品全都可以吃。

examples.en: The newspaper published an editorial about public transportation.
examples.zh: 報紙刊登了一篇關於大眾運輸的社論。

examples.en: She wrote an editorial on school lunches for the student paper.
examples.zh: 她替校刊寫了一篇關於學校營養午餐的社論。

examples.en: Today's editorial praises the city's new recycling program.
examples.zh: 今天的社論稱讚這座城市新的資源回收計畫。

examples.en: The editorial staff meets every Monday morning.
examples.zh: 編輯部人員每週一早上開會。

examples.en: He made several editorial changes to the report.
examples.zh: 他對報告做了幾處編輯上的修改。

examples.en: The magazine has a strong editorial team.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌有一支堅強的編輯團隊。

examples.en: We called an electrician to fix the broken light switch.
examples.zh: 我們請了電工來修壞掉的電燈開關。

examples.en: My uncle works as an electrician for a construction company.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在一家建設公司當電工。

examples.en: The electrician checked all the wires before turning on the power.
examples.zh: 電工在開電源前檢查了所有的電線。

examples.en: Running a marathon requires great endurance and months of regular training.
examples.zh: 跑馬拉松需要很強的耐力，以及數個月的規律訓練。

examples.en: The team showed real endurance in the final match.
examples.zh: 球隊在決賽中展現出真正的持久力。

examples.en: Her endurance helped her finish the long hike.
examples.zh: 她的耐力幫助她完成了這次長程健行。

examples.en: Good lighting can enhance the look of a room.
examples.zh: 良好的照明可以提升房間的質感。

examples.en: Reading every day will enhance your vocabulary.
examples.zh: 每天閱讀會增加你的字彙量。

examples.en: The new software enhances the quality of old photos.
examples.zh: 這套新軟體能改善舊照片的畫質。

examples.en: She decided to enroll in a night class at the community college.
examples.zh: 她決定到社區大學報名夜間課程。

examples.en: Parents must enroll their children before the school year starts.
examples.zh: 家長必須在學年開始前替孩子辦理入學。

examples.en: Over two hundred students enrolled in the summer program.
examples.zh: 有兩百多名學生報名了暑期課程。

examples.en: The examiner asked me to introduce myself in English.
examples.zh: 考官請我用英文自我介紹。

examples.en: Each examiner watches ten students during the test.
examples.zh: 每位考官在考試中負責監看十名學生。

examples.en: An examiner from the health department visited the restaurant.
examples.zh: 衛生局的檢查員來到這家餐廳視察。

examples.en: Grandma's eyesight is getting worse as she gets older.
examples.zh: 奶奶年紀越大，視力越差。

examples.en: Eating carrots is said to be good for your eyesight.
examples.zh: 據說吃紅蘿蔔對視力有益。

examples.en: He has excellent eyesight and can read the small sign from far away.
examples.zh: 他視力極佳，從很遠的地方就能看清楚小告示。

examples.en: The teacher read us a fable about a clever fox.
examples.zh: 老師唸了一則關於聰明狐狸的寓言給我們聽。

examples.en: Every fable ends with a lesson about life.
examples.zh: 每則寓言都以一個人生教訓作結。

examples.en: This old fable is still popular with children around the world.
examples.zh: 這則古老的寓言仍受到世界各地孩子的喜愛。

examples.en: The farmer spread fertilizer over the rice field.
examples.zh: 農夫把肥料撒在稻田裡。

examples.en: Too much fertilizer can harm young plants.
examples.zh: 太多肥料可能傷害幼苗。

examples.en: We bought a bag of fertilizer for the garden.
examples.zh: 我們替花園買了一袋肥料。

examples.en: The fragrance of fresh flowers filled the living room.
examples.zh: 新鮮花朵的香味瀰漫了客廳。

examples.en: She wore a light fragrance to the interview.
examples.zh: 她面試時擦了淡淡的香水。

examples.en: This soap has a pleasant lemon fragrance.
examples.zh: 這塊肥皂有宜人的檸檬香味。

examples.en: The freeway was crowded with cars during the holiday.
examples.zh: 假日期間，高速公路上擠滿了車。

examples.en: We took the freeway to save time.
examples.zh: 我們走高速公路以節省時間。

examples.en: There is a freeway exit near our school.
examples.zh: 我們學校附近有一個高速公路出口。

examples.en: The old movie is about a famous gangster in the 1930s.
examples.zh: 這部老電影講的是一九三○年代一位著名的幫派份子。

examples.en: The author wrote a novel about a gangster who wanted a new life.
examples.zh: 作者寫了一本小說，內容是一個想展開新生活的幫派份子。

examples.en: Police say the gangster has left the city.
examples.zh: 警方表示那名幫派份子已經離開這座城市。

examples.en: The city holds a parade to celebrate gay rights every year.
examples.zh: 這座城市每年都舉辦遊行來慶祝同志權益。

examples.en: He has many gay friends at work.
examples.zh: 他在公司有很多同志朋友。

examples.en: The film tells a touching story about a gay couple.
examples.zh: 這部電影描述了一對同志伴侶的動人故事。

examples.en: The law protects gays from unfair treatment at work.
examples.zh: 法律保障同志在職場上不受不公平的對待。

examples.en: The group helps young gays feel accepted.
examples.zh: 這個團體幫助年輕的同志感到被接納。

examples.en: Many gays and lesbians joined the community event.
examples.zh: 許多男同志與女同志參加了這場社區活動。

examples.en: The swan glided across the quiet lake.
examples.zh: 天鵝滑過平靜的湖面。

examples.en: Eagles glide high above the mountains without moving their wings.
examples.zh: 老鷹不拍動翅膀，在高山上空滑翔。

examples.en: The skater glided smoothly over the ice.
examples.zh: 溜冰選手在冰面上順暢地滑行。

examples.en: The bird made a long glide down to the river.
examples.zh: 那隻鳥滑翔了很長一段距離，降到了河面。

examples.en: She finished her routine with a graceful glide.
examples.zh: 她以優雅的滑行結束了她的表演。

examples.en: The plane made a gentle glide toward the runway.
examples.zh: 飛機平穩地朝跑道滑翔。

examples.en: I drink a glass of grapefruit juice every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早上都喝一杯葡萄柚汁。

examples.en: This grapefruit is a little bitter but very fresh.
examples.zh: 這顆葡萄柚有點苦，但很新鮮。

examples.en: She cut the grapefruit in half and shared it with me.
examples.zh: 她把葡萄柚切成兩半，和我分著吃。

examples.en: Not speaking the local language was a big handicap for him.
examples.zh: 不會說當地語言對他是個很大的不利條件。

examples.en: The school has ramps for students with a physical handicap.
examples.zh: 學校為身體有障礙的學生設置了坡道。

examples.en: Being short is not a handicap in this sport.
examples.zh: 個子矮在這項運動中並不是劣勢。

examples.en: A lack of money will handicap the young team.
examples.zh: 缺乏資金會讓這支年輕的球隊處於不利地位。

examples.en: Heavy rain handicapped the rescue work in the mountain village.
examples.zh: 大雨妨礙了山村裡的救援工作。

examples.en: Slow internet can handicap online learning by interrupting live video lessons.
examples.zh: 網路速度太慢可能使即時視訊課程中斷，妨礙線上學習。

examples.en: The cement will harden in about two hours.
examples.zh: 水泥大約兩小時後會變硬。

examples.en: Cold weather hardened the soil in the garden.
examples.zh: 寒冷的天氣讓花園裡的土壤變硬了。

examples.en: Years of hard work hardened her spirit.
examples.zh: 多年的辛勤工作磨練了她的意志。

examples.en: The movie is about a plot to hijack a plane.
examples.zh: 這部電影的內容是一項劫機的陰謀。

examples.en: Hackers tried to hijack the company's website.
examples.zh: 駭客企圖劫持這家公司的網站。

examples.en: Some people tried to hijack the meeting with unrelated topics.
examples.zh: 有些人想用無關的話題來把持會議。

examples.en: The airline trained its staff to handle a hijack.
examples.zh: 航空公司訓練員工應對劫機事件。

examples.en: The news story reported a hijack in the 1970s.
examples.zh: 這則新聞報導了一九七○年代的一起劫機事件。

examples.en: The hijack ended safely after a few hours.
examples.zh: 這起劫持事件在幾小時後平安落幕。

examples.en: We stayed at a cheap hostel near the train station.
examples.zh: 我們住在火車站附近一間便宜的青年旅館。

examples.en: The hostel offers free breakfast for all guests.
examples.zh: 這間青年旅館提供所有房客免費早餐。

examples.en: She met travelers from many countries at the hostel.
examples.zh: 她在青年旅館認識了來自許多國家的旅客。

examples.en: The ship carefully avoided the huge iceberg.
examples.zh: 那艘船小心地避開了巨大的冰山。

examples.en: Most of an iceberg is hidden under the water.
examples.zh: 冰山的大部分都藏在水面下。

examples.en: Scientists studied a giant iceberg near the South Pole.
examples.zh: 科學家研究了南極附近的一座巨大冰山。

examples.en: The imperial palace attracts thousands of tourists every year.
examples.zh: 這座皇宮每年吸引數千名遊客。

examples.en: The museum displays gifts from the imperial family.
examples.zh: 博物館展出皇室家族的禮物。

examples.en: The recipe uses imperial measurements such as ounces and pounds.
examples.zh: 這份食譜使用盎司和磅等英制單位。

examples.en: The country began to industrialize in the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 這個國家在十九世紀開始工業化。

examples.en: Many nations want to industrialize their economies quickly.
examples.zh: 許多國家希望讓經濟快速工業化。

examples.en: Cities grew fast as the region started to industrialize.
examples.zh: 隨著這個地區開始工業化，城市快速成長。

examples.en: From her smile, I inferred that she passed the test.
examples.zh: 從她的笑容，我推斷她通過了考試。

examples.en: What can you infer from this graph?
examples.zh: 你能從這張圖表推論出什麼？

examples.en: Readers can infer the writer's opinion from the title.
examples.zh: 讀者可以從標題推斷作者的看法。

examples.en: The town has about five thousand inhabitants.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮大約有五千名居民。

examples.en: The inhabitants of the island rely on fishing.
examples.zh: 島上的居民靠捕魚維生。

examples.en: Penguins are the only inhabitants of this icy coast.
examples.zh: 企鵝是這片冰冷海岸唯一的居民。

examples.en: The interpreter translated the speech into English.
examples.zh: 口譯員把演講翻成了英文。

examples.en: We hired an interpreter for our business meeting in Tokyo.
examples.zh: 我們為在東京的商務會議請了一位口譯員。

examples.en: She works as a sign language interpreter at the hospital.
examples.zh: 她在醫院擔任手語翻譯員。

examples.en: I am sorry to intrude, but may I ask a question?
examples.zh: 很抱歉打擾，我可以問個問題嗎？

examples.en: Reporters should not intrude on people's private lives.
examples.zh: 記者不該侵擾別人的私生活。

examples.en: A stranger intruded into our private party.
examples.zh: 一位陌生人闖進了我們的私人派對。

examples.en: The alarm rang when an intruder entered the building.
examples.zh: 有人闖入大樓時，警報器響了。

examples.en: The dog barked loudly at the intruder.
examples.zh: 狗對著闖入者大聲吠叫。

examples.en: The security camera recorded the intruder's face.
examples.zh: 監視器拍下了闖入者的臉。

examples.en: I have an itch on my back that I cannot reach.
examples.zh: 我背上有個地方癢，搆不到。

examples.en: The cream stopped the itch right away.
examples.zh: 這條藥膏馬上止住了癢。

examples.en: An itch from the mosquito bite kept him awake.
examples.zh: 蚊子叮咬造成的癢讓他睡不著。

examples.en: My arm itches after the mosquito bite.
examples.zh: 被蚊子叮之後，我的手臂發癢。

examples.en: The new wool sweater itches a little.
examples.zh: 這件新的羊毛衣有點刺癢。

examples.en: He is itching to try the new game.
examples.zh: 他迫不及待想玩這款新遊戲。

examples.en: Our guide was very knowledgeable about local history.
examples.zh: 我們的導遊對當地歷史非常了解。

examples.en: She is a knowledgeable teacher who loves answering questions.
examples.zh: 她是一位學識淵博、喜歡回答問題的老師。

examples.en: The shop staff are friendly and knowledgeable about computers.
examples.zh: 這家店的店員很親切，對電腦也很在行。

examples.en: My landlady lives on the first floor of the building.
examples.zh: 我的女房東住在這棟樓的一樓。

examples.en: The landlady raised the rent last month.
examples.zh: 女房東上個月調漲了房租。

examples.en: The landlady of the inn welcomed us with hot tea.
examples.zh: 旅館的女老闆端了熱茶來歡迎我們。

examples.en: A landslide blocked the mountain road after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後，山崩堵住了山路。

examples.en: The village was damaged by a landslide last summer.
examples.zh: 這座村莊去年夏天因山崩而受損。

examples.en: The mayor won the election by a landslide.
examples.zh: 市長以壓倒性的票數贏得選舉。

examples.en: Taipei is located at a latitude of about twenty-five degrees north.
examples.zh: 台北位於北緯約二十五度。

examples.en: Places at high latitude have very long winters.
examples.zh: 高緯度的地方冬天很長。

examples.en: The teacher gave students some latitude in choosing their topics.
examples.zh: 老師讓學生在選題上有一些自由。

examples.en: The army liberated the city in 1945.
examples.zh: 軍隊在一九四五年解放了這座城市。

examples.en: Volunteers liberated the birds from the small cages.
examples.zh: 志工把鳥從小籠子裡放了出來。

examples.en: Technology can liberate people from boring housework.
examples.zh: 科技可以讓人從無聊的家事中解放出來。

examples.en: Please lighten your bag before the long hike.
examples.zh: 長途健行前，請減輕你的行囊重量。

examples.en: A joke from the teacher lightened the mood in the classroom.
examples.zh: 老師的一個笑話讓教室的氣氛輕鬆起來。

examples.en: We painted the walls to lighten the dark room.
examples.zh: 我們粉刷牆壁，讓昏暗的房間變亮。

examples.en: I put lotion on my hands after washing the dishes.
examples.zh: 洗完碗後，我在手上擦乳液。

examples.en: This sunscreen lotion is safe for children.
examples.zh: 這款防曬乳液對孩子很安全。

examples.en: She bought a bottle of body lotion at the drugstore.
examples.zh: 她在藥妝店買了一瓶身體乳液。

examples.en: The principal's voice came through the loudspeaker.
examples.zh: 校長的聲音從擴音器傳出來。

examples.en: A loudspeaker on the train announced the next stop.
examples.zh: 火車上的擴音器廣播了下一站。

examples.en: They placed a large loudspeaker on the stage for the concert.
examples.zh: 他們在舞台上放了一個大喇叭來辦音樂會。

examples.en: Mom sang a lullaby to help the baby fall asleep.
examples.zh: 媽媽唱搖籃曲幫寶寶入睡。

examples.en: The soft lullaby made me feel sleepy.
examples.zh: 輕柔的搖籃曲讓我覺得想睡。

examples.en: Grandma still remembers the lullaby she sang to us.
examples.zh: 奶奶還記得她以前唱給我們聽的搖籃曲。

examples.en: The lunar eclipse could be seen from our balcony.
examples.zh: 我們從陽台就能看到月蝕。

examples.en: Our family gets together every Lunar New Year.
examples.zh: 我們全家每年農曆新年都會團聚。

examples.en: Scientists studied rocks brought back from the lunar surface.
examples.zh: 科學家研究了從月球表面帶回來的岩石。

examples.en: Can I help you find your seat, madam?
examples.zh: 女士，需要我幫您找座位嗎？

examples.en: Dear Madam, I am writing to ask about the job.
examples.zh: 敬啟者，我來信是想詢問這份工作。

examples.en: Madam Chair, I would like to make a suggestion.
examples.zh: 主席女士，我想提出一項建議。

examples.en: Ferries run between the island and the mainland every hour.
examples.zh: 渡輪每小時往返於島嶼與本土之間。

examples.en: We took a boat from the island to the mainland.
examples.zh: 我們搭船從島上到本土。

examples.en: Many tourists from the mainland visit the island in summer.
examples.zh: 許多來自大陸的遊客在夏天造訪這座島。

examples.en: The mainland coast is only ten kilometers away.
examples.zh: 本土的海岸線只有十公里遠。

examples.en: Mainland weather is often different from the island's.
examples.zh: 本土的天氣常常和島上不同。

examples.en: They live in a mainland town near the sea.
examples.zh: 他們住在靠海的一座本土城鎮。

examples.en: The mistress of the house welcomed every guest at the door.
examples.zh: 這間房子的女主人在門口迎接每一位客人。

examples.en: The dog waited by the gate for its mistress to come home.
examples.zh: 那隻狗在大門旁等牠的女主人回家。

examples.en: The old mistress at the village school loved teaching music.
examples.zh: 那所鄉村學校的老女老師很喜歡教音樂。

examples.en: My father likes to mow the lawn on Saturday mornings.
examples.zh: 我爸爸喜歡在週六早上割草坪的草。

examples.en: We need to mow the grass before the guests arrive.
examples.zh: 我們得在客人到達前把草割好。

examples.en: The gardener mowed the field behind the school last week.
examples.zh: 園丁上週把學校後面的草地割過了。

examples.en: Fresh fruit and vegetables nourish the body.
examples.zh: 新鮮的水果和蔬菜能滋養身體。

examples.en: The farmer nourished the young plants with rich soil.
examples.zh: 農夫用肥沃的土壤滋養這些幼苗。

examples.en: Good teachers nourish a love of reading in their students.
examples.zh: 好老師會培養學生對閱讀的喜愛。

senses.zh: 整齊的；有條理的；守秩序的

examples.en: Her desk is always clean and orderly.
examples.zh: 她的書桌總是乾淨又整齊。

examples.en: The students left the classroom in an orderly line.
examples.zh: 學生們排成整齊的隊伍離開教室。

examples.en: An orderly schedule helps me finish my homework on time.
examples.zh: 有條理的時間表幫助我準時完成作業。

examples.en: The children at the orphanage were happy to receive new books.
examples.zh: 孤兒院的孩子們很高興收到新書。

examples.en: She grew up in an orphanage in a small town.
examples.zh: 她在一個小鎮的孤兒院長大。

examples.en: Our class collected winter clothes for the local orphanage.
examples.zh: 我們班為當地的孤兒院募集了冬季衣物。

examples.en: Add one ounce of butter to the pan.
examples.zh: 在鍋子裡加入一盎司的奶油。

examples.en: The package of tea weighs about two ounces.
examples.zh: 這包茶葉大約重兩盎司。

examples.en: This small bottle holds eight ounces of juice.
examples.zh: 這個小瓶子可以裝八液量盎司的果汁。

examples.en: The outward swing of the door leaves more space inside.
examples.zh: 這扇門向外開啟，讓室內多出一些空間。

examples.en: Despite his calm outward manner, he was very nervous.
examples.zh: 儘管他外表鎮定，其實非常緊張。

examples.en: The outward appearance of the old house has not changed.
examples.zh: 這棟老房子的外觀沒有改變。

examples.en: The windows open outward to let in the breeze.
examples.zh: 這些窗戶向外開，好讓微風吹進來。

examples.en: The ripples in the pond spread outward from the stone.
examples.zh: 池塘裡的漣漪從石頭處向外擴散。

examples.en: Turn your toes outward when you stretch your legs.
examples.zh: 伸展雙腿時，腳尖要朝外。

examples.en: The river may overflow after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後，河水可能會氾濫。

examples.en: Don't fill the cup too much, or the tea will overflow.
examples.zh: 杯子別倒太滿，否則茶會溢出來。

examples.en: The hall was so crowded that people overflowed into the hallway.
examples.zh: 大廳擠得水洩不通，人潮都擠到走廊上了。

examples.en: Put a bucket under the pipe to catch the overflow.
examples.zh: 在水管下放一個水桶來接溢出的水。

examples.en: The overflow of visitors forced the museum to close its doors early.
examples.zh: 湧入的遊客太多，博物館提早關門。

examples.en: A drain was built to carry the overflow away from the street.
examples.zh: 為了把多餘的水排離街道，人們蓋了排水溝。

examples.en: I bought a packet of cookies at the supermarket.
examples.zh: 我在超市買了一包餅乾。

examples.en: She tore open the packet of sugar and stirred it into her coffee.
examples.zh: 她撕開糖包，把糖倒進咖啡裡攪拌。

examples.en: The teacher handed each student a packet of worksheets.
examples.zh: 老師發給每位學生一疊學習單。

examples.en: The parliament will vote on the new education law next week.
examples.zh: 國會下週將針對新的教育法案進行表決。

examples.en: Members of parliament meet in the capital city.
examples.zh: 國會議員在首都開會。

examples.en: Students visited the parliament building on their school trip.
examples.zh: 學生們在校外教學時參觀了國會大廈。

examples.en: Many people sing patriotic songs on National Day.
examples.zh: 許多人在國慶日唱愛國歌曲。

examples.en: He felt patriotic when he saw the flag rise.
examples.zh: 看到國旗升起時，他感到十分愛國。

examples.en: The students gave a patriotic speech at the school ceremony.
examples.zh: 學生們在學校典禮上發表了愛國演說。

examples.en: The children collected smooth pebbles along the beach.
examples.zh: 孩子們沿著海灘撿拾光滑的小石子。

examples.en: A small pebble got stuck in my shoe.
examples.zh: 一顆小石子卡在我的鞋子裡。

examples.en: He skipped a flat pebble across the calm lake.
examples.zh: 他用一顆扁平的小石子在平靜的湖面上打水漂。

examples.en: We stopped to buy petrol before the long drive.
examples.zh: 長途開車前，我們停下來加汽油。

examples.en: The price of petrol went up again this month.
examples.zh: 這個月汽油的價格又上漲了。

examples.en: This car uses less petrol than my old one.
examples.zh: 這輛車比我的舊車更省油。

examples.en: The pianist played a gentle song at the school concert.
examples.zh: 這位鋼琴家在學校音樂會上彈了一首輕柔的曲子。

examples.en: My sister wants to become a professional pianist.
examples.zh: 我姊姊想成為專業的鋼琴家。

examples.en: The famous pianist signed autographs after the show.
examples.zh: 那位著名的鋼琴家在演出後幫大家簽名。

examples.en: Thousands of pilgrims visit the temple every year.
examples.zh: 每年有數千名朝聖者造訪這座廟宇。

examples.en: The pilgrims walked for days to reach the holy mountain.
examples.zh: 朝聖者們走了好幾天才到達聖山。

examples.en: A tired pilgrim stopped to rest by the road.
examples.zh: 一位疲憊的朝聖者停在路邊休息。

examples.en: The little girl rode a pony at the farm.
examples.zh: 小女孩在牧場騎了一匹小馬。

examples.en: A brown pony was eating grass beside the fence.
examples.zh: 一匹棕色的小馬正在圍欄邊吃草。

examples.en: Children can ride the pony for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 孩子們可以騎小馬十分鐘。

examples.en: The porter carried our bags to the hotel room.
examples.zh: 行李員幫我們把行李提到飯店房間。

examples.en: A railway porter helped the old man with his suitcase.
examples.zh: 一位車站搬運工幫那位老先生提行李箱。

examples.en: Please ask the porter at the front desk for a taxi.
examples.zh: 請櫃檯的門房幫忙叫一輛計程車。

examples.en: The farmer keeps poultry such as chickens and ducks.
examples.zh: 農夫養了雞和鴨之類的家禽。

examples.en: Poultry is a common source of protein in many countries.
examples.zh: 家禽肉在許多國家是常見的蛋白質來源。

examples.en: My uncle owns a small poultry farm near the village.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在村子附近有一座小型家禽養殖場。

examples.en: We watched the movie preview before buying tickets.
examples.zh: 我們買票之前先看了電影預告。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a preview of next week's lesson.
examples.zh: 老師預先向我們介紹了下週課程的內容。

examples.en: There will be a special preview of the new exhibition on Friday.
examples.zh: 新展覽將在週五舉辦特別預展。

examples.en: You can preview the document before you print it.
examples.zh: 你可以在列印文件之前先預覽。

examples.en: The company will preview its new phone next month.
examples.zh: 這家公司下個月將預先展示新手機。

examples.en: Please preview the chapter before class tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天上課前請先預習這一章。

examples.en: There is an old proverb about hard work.
examples.zh: 有一句關於努力工作的古老諺語。

examples.en: My grandmother often quotes a proverb when I feel lazy.
examples.zh: 我覺得懶散時，奶奶常引用一句諺語。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to explain the meaning of the proverb.
examples.zh: 老師要我們解釋這句諺語的意思。

examples.en: Our teacher is always punctual and never late for class.
examples.zh: 我們的老師總是很守時，上課從不遲到。

examples.en: Please be punctual for the interview tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 明天早上的面試請準時到。

examples.en: The train service in this city is very punctual.
examples.zh: 這個城市的火車服務非常準時。

examples.en: She has the right qualifications for the job.
examples.zh: 她具備這份工作所需的資格。

examples.en: A teaching certificate is an important qualification for this position.
examples.zh: 教師證書是這個職位的重要資格。

examples.en: You need a basic qualification in English to apply.
examples.zh: 你需要具備基本的英語資格認證才能申請。

examples.en: A cold shower will refresh you after the hike.
examples.zh: 健行後沖個冷水澡會讓你精神一振。

examples.en: Please refresh the page if the video does not load.
examples.zh: 如果影片沒有載入，請重新整理頁面。

examples.en: I need a short break to refresh my mind before the exam.
examples.zh: 考試前我需要短暫休息，讓頭腦恢復清醒。

examples.en: The students rehearse the school play every afternoon.
examples.zh: 學生們每天下午都在排練學校的戲劇。

examples.en: She rehearsed her speech in front of the mirror.
examples.zh: 她對著鏡子預演自己的演講。

examples.en: We will rehearse the song again before the concert.
examples.zh: 音樂會前我們會再排練一次這首歌。

senses.zh: 抗拒的；有抵抗力的；耐……的

examples.en: This jacket is resistant to water, making it suitable for light rain.
examples.zh: 這件外套具有抗水性，適合在小雨時穿。

examples.en: Some bacteria are resistant to common medicine.
examples.zh: 有些細菌對常見的藥物有抗藥性。

examples.en: Many people are resistant to change at work.
examples.zh: 許多人在工作上抗拒改變。

examples.en: Please put your rubbish in the bin.
examples.zh: 請把你的垃圾丟進垃圾桶。

examples.en: The claim that our school is closing is complete rubbish.
examples.zh: 我們學校要關門的說法完全是胡說。

examples.en: We collect the rubbish every Tuesday morning.
examples.zh: 我們每週二早上收垃圾。

examples.en: A seagull landed on the railing near our table.
examples.zh: 一隻海鷗停在我們餐桌旁的欄杆上。

examples.en: The seagulls followed the fishing boat back to the harbor.
examples.zh: 海鷗們跟著漁船回到港口。

examples.en: We heard a seagull crying above the beach.
examples.zh: 我們聽到一隻海鷗在海灘上空鳴叫。

examples.en: Please sharpen your pencil before the test starts.
examples.zh: 考試開始前請把鉛筆削尖。

examples.en: My father sharpens the kitchen knives every month.
examples.zh: 我爸爸每個月都會把廚房的刀磨利。

examples.en: Reading every day will sharpen your English skills.
examples.zh: 每天閱讀能增強你的英文能力。

examples.en: My brother bought an electric shaver for his birthday.
examples.zh: 我弟弟買了一支電動刮鬍刀當生日禮物。

examples.en: This shaver is easy to clean and charge.
examples.zh: 這支刮鬍刀很容易清潔和充電。

examples.en: Don't forget to pack your shaver for the trip.
examples.zh: 別忘了把你的刮鬍刀放進旅行行李。

examples.en: Poor battery life is the main shortcoming of this phone.
examples.zh: 電池續航力差是這支手機的主要缺點。

examples.en: Everyone has shortcomings, so we should be patient with each other.
examples.zh: 每個人都有缺點，所以我們應該彼此包容。

examples.en: The report pointed out several shortcomings in the plan.
examples.zh: 報告指出了這項計畫的幾個不足之處。

examples.en: The teacher tried to simplify the grammar rules for us.
examples.zh: 老師試著為我們簡化文法規則。

examples.en: We should simplify the form so that everyone can fill it out.
examples.zh: 我們應該簡化這份表格，讓每個人都能填寫。

examples.en: A clear map will simplify the trip for new visitors.
examples.zh: 一張清楚的地圖能讓新來的遊客旅行更輕鬆。

examples.en: I usually skim the news headlines on my phone every morning.
examples.zh: 我通常每天早上用手機瀏覽新聞標題。

examples.en: Skim the text first, and then answer the questions.
examples.zh: 先把文章略讀一遍，再回答問題。

examples.en: A bird skimmed over the surface of the lake.
examples.zh: 一隻鳥掠過湖面。

examples.en: Teenagers often use slang when they talk with friends.
examples.zh: 青少年和朋友聊天時常使用俚語。

examples.en: My teacher explained the slang in the song lyrics.
examples.zh: 我的老師解釋了歌詞裡的俚語。

examples.en: It is hard to learn slang from a dictionary.
examples.zh: 要從字典裡學會俚語很困難。

examples.en: Cover your mouth and nose with a tissue when you sneeze.
examples.zh: 打噴嚏時，請用衛生紙摀住口鼻。

examples.en: The dust in the old room made me sneeze.
examples.zh: 那間舊房間裡的灰塵讓我打噴嚏。

examples.en: He sneezed three times in a row during class.
examples.zh: 他在課堂上連續打了三個噴嚏。

examples.en: I heard a loud sneeze from the back of the room.
examples.zh: 我聽到房間後面傳來很大聲的噴嚏。

examples.en: A sneeze can be a sign of a cold.
examples.zh: 打噴嚏可能是感冒的徵兆。

examples.en: She tried to hold back a sneeze during the meeting.
examples.zh: 她在會議中努力忍住噴嚏。

examples.en: My sister is a sociable girl who makes friends easily.
examples.zh: 我妹妹是個好交際的女孩，很容易交到朋友。

examples.en: He is not very sociable and prefers to read at home.
examples.zh: 他不太愛交際，比較喜歡待在家看書。

examples.en: A sociable neighbor invited us to dinner on our first day.
examples.zh: 一位好交際的鄰居在我們搬來的第一天就邀請我們吃晚餐。

examples.en: The spacecraft will travel to Mars in two years.
examples.zh: 這艘太空船將在兩年後前往火星。

examples.en: Students watched a video of the spacecraft landing.
examples.zh: 學生們觀看了太空船登陸的影片。

examples.en: Scientists use a small spacecraft to study distant planets.
examples.zh: 科學家利用小型太空船研究遙遠的行星。

examples.en: A sparrow was singing on the roof this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上有一隻麻雀在屋頂上鳴叫。

examples.en: Sparrows often come to the park to look for crumbs.
examples.zh: 麻雀常到公園裡尋找麵包屑。

examples.en: The little sparrow built a nest under our window.
examples.zh: 那隻小麻雀在我們的窗下築了巢。

examples.en: The coach praised the team for its good sportsmanship.
examples.zh: 教練稱讚這支隊伍有良好的運動精神。

examples.en: Shaking hands after the game shows sportsmanship.
examples.zh: 比賽後握手顯示出運動家風範。

examples.en: Good sportsmanship is more important than winning.
examples.zh: 良好的運動精神比獲勝更重要。

examples.en: Many people in the region suffered from starvation after the drought.
examples.zh: 乾旱過後，這個地區有許多人遭受飢餓之苦。

examples.en: The charity works to end starvation around the world.
examples.zh: 這個慈善機構致力於消除全世界的飢餓問題。

examples.en: The animals nearly died of starvation during the long winter.
examples.zh: 在漫長的冬天裡，這些動物差點餓死。

examples.en: My stepfather cooks dinner for us every weekend.
examples.zh: 我的繼父每個週末都會為我們煮晚餐。

examples.en: She gets along well with her stepfather.
examples.zh: 她和繼父相處得很好。

examples.en: His stepfather taught him how to ride a bike.
examples.zh: 他的繼父教他騎腳踏車。

examples.en: Her stepmother helps her with homework after school.
examples.zh: 她的繼母放學後會協助她做功課。

examples.en: My stepmother is a kind woman who loves gardening.
examples.zh: 我的繼母是個喜歡園藝的親切女性。

examples.en: He invited his stepmother to the school concert.
examples.zh: 他邀請繼母來參加學校音樂會。

examples.en: I packed my clothes in a small suitcase.
examples.zh: 我把衣服裝進一個小行李箱。

examples.en: Her suitcase was too heavy to lift onto the bus.
examples.zh: 她的行李箱太重，沒辦法抬上公車。

examples.en: Please wait here while I get my suitcase from the belt.
examples.zh: 我去輸送帶拿行李箱，請在這裡等我。

examples.en: The school announced the suspension of classes because of the typhoon.
examples.zh: 學校因颱風宣布停課。

examples.en: The player received a two-game suspension for breaking the rules.
examples.zh: 那位球員因違規被禁賽兩場。

examples.en: This bike has a good suspension for rough roads.
examples.zh: 這輛腳踏車的懸吊系統很適合崎嶇的道路。

examples.en: The white dove symbolizes peace in many cultures around the world.
examples.zh: 在世界各地的許多文化中，白鴿象徵和平。

examples.en: Red envelopes symbolize good luck in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 紅包在台灣象徵好運。

examples.en: The tree in the picture symbolizes growth.
examples.zh: 圖中的樹象徵成長。

examples.en: I sympathize with you because I failed the test last year too.
examples.zh: 我很同情你，因為我去年考試也不及格。

examples.en: It is hard not to sympathize with the lost child.
examples.zh: 很難不去同情那個走失的孩子。

examples.en: She listened and sympathized when her friend talked about the problem.
examples.zh: 朋友談到問題時，她傾聽並表示同情。

examples.en: The city orchestra will play a symphony by Beethoven tonight.
examples.zh: 市立管弦樂團今晚將演奏貝多芬的一首交響曲。

examples.en: My parents bought tickets to the symphony for my birthday.
examples.zh: 我爸媽買了交響樂音樂會的票當作我的生日禮物。

examples.en: The symphony lasted almost an hour and ended with a powerful finale.
examples.zh: 這首交響曲長達將近一個小時，並以強而有力的終章作結。

examples.en: She poured maple syrup on her pancakes.
examples.zh: 她把楓糖漿淋在鬆餅上。

examples.en: The doctor gave the boy cough syrup for his cold.
examples.zh: 醫生開了止咳糖漿給這個男孩治療感冒。

examples.en: Peaches are often kept in sweet syrup in cans.
examples.zh: 桃子常被泡在甜糖水裡裝成罐頭。

examples.en: The new tenant moved into the apartment last week.
examples.zh: 新房客上週搬進了這間公寓。

examples.en: Tenants must pay the rent at the beginning of each month.
examples.zh: 房客必須在每個月初繳房租。

examples.en: The landlord called a meeting for all the tenants.
examples.zh: 房東召集了所有房客開會。

examples.en: The little boy stood on tiptoe to reach the shelf.
examples.zh: 小男孩踮起腳尖，想搆到架子。

examples.en: She walked on tiptoe so she would not wake the baby.
examples.zh: 她踮著腳尖走路，以免吵醒寶寶。

examples.en: We stood on tiptoe to see over the crowd.
examples.zh: 我們踮著腳尖，好越過人群往前看。

examples.en: He tiptoed into the room so he would not wake his sister.
examples.zh: 他躡手躡腳地走進房間，以免吵醒妹妹。

examples.en: The cat tiptoed across the kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 那隻貓躡手躡腳地走過廚房地板。

examples.en: Please tiptoe past the office because the meeting is still on.
examples.zh: 會議還在進行，請輕手輕腳地經過辦公室。

examples.en: The long wait at the airport was tiresome.
examples.zh: 在機場的漫長等待令人厭煩。

examples.en: I find filling out so much paperwork tiresome.
examples.zh: 我覺得填寫這麼多文書資料很煩人。

examples.en: It is tiresome to hear the same joke again and again.
examples.zh: 一再聽到同一個笑話很令人厭煩。
